effect.sentenceEn: Long working hours contribute to the feeling of "time poverty", which has an adverse effect on psychological well-being.
effect.translationZh: 长时间工作导致了"时间贫困"感，这对心理健康产生了不利影响。
effect.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

effect.sentenceEn: Further, under normal working conditions, managers rarely see the full effect of their employee development efforts.
effect.translationZh: 此外，在正常工作条件下，管理者很少能看到其员工发展努力的全部效果。
effect.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

effect.sentenceEn: A paper by Bowker and her colleagues was the first to show that a type of social withdrawal could have a positive effect —they found that creativity was linked specifically to unsociability.
effect.translationZh: Bowker及其同事的一篇论文首次表明，某种类型的社交退缩可能产生积极影响——他们发现创造力与不合群特质存在特定关联。

effect.sentenceEn: The researchers believed that focusing on one's phone instead of the person one is with has this effect because it's seen as a form of social exclusion.
effect.translationZh: 研究人员认为，相比于身边的同伴更关注手机会产生这种影响，是因为这种行为被视为一种社交排斥。
effect.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

effect.sentenceEn: These negative effects are similar to those caused by traditional forms of social exclusion.
effect.translationZh: 这些负面影响与传统形式的社会排斥所造成的影响相似。
effect.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

effect.sentenceEn: The effect of school absences on American education is worrisome.
effect.translationZh: 缺课对美国教育的影响令人担忧。

employee.sentenceEn: In the U.S., full time employees work an average of 8.72 hours per day despite productivity increases.
employee.translationZh: 在美国，尽管生产力有所提高，全职员工平均每天仍工作8.72小时。
employee.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

employee.sentenceEn: But in branches where employees were more active, introverted(内向的) leaders were more effective.
employee.translationZh: 但在员工更为积极主动的部门中，内向型领导者的工作效率更高。

employee.sentenceEn: But this depends, among other things, on the personalities of their employees .
employee.translationZh: 但这一点，除其他因素外，取决于员工的个性。

employee.sentenceEn: One 2011 study showed that in branches of a pizza chain where employees were more passive, outgoing bosses were associated with higher profits.
employee.translationZh: 2011年的一项研究显示，在员工较为被动的披萨连锁店分店中，外向的老板与更高的利润相关联。

employee.sentenceEn: What did the speaker and his counterpart do when the two employees gave different accounts of the same event?
employee.translationZh: 当两名员工对同一事件的叙述不一致时，演讲者及其同行是如何处理的？

employee.sentenceEn: They help managers achieve the full effect of employee development efforts.
employee.translationZh: 它们帮助管理者充分发挥员工发展工作的效果。

economic.sentenceEn: Place-based economic development stresses the importance of offering attractive, functional, and community-based places, such as libraries, in town squares and depressed neighborhoods.
economic.translationZh: 区位经济发展强调提供有吸引力、功能性强且以社区为基础的场所的重要性，例如城镇广场和经济欠发达社区中的图书馆。

economic.sentenceEn: I also found that promoting the pursuit of one's passion helps perpetuate social inequalities due to the fact that not everyone has the same economic resources to allow them to pursue their passion with ease.
economic.translationZh: 我还发现，宣扬追求个人热情会加剧社会不平等，因为并非每个人都拥有同样的经济资源，能够轻松追求自己的热爱。
economic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

economic.sentenceEn: Like a major department store in a mall, libraries attract large numbers of people, creating economic opportunities for numerous businesses and organizations in the surrounding area.
economic.translationZh: 图书馆如同商场中的大型百货公司，吸引着大量人群，为周边地区的众多企业和机构创造了经济机会。

economic.sentenceEn: Free tutoring, homework help programs, and summer reading programs for kids and teens help bridge the economic divide that impacts students' academic performance.
economic.translationZh: 为儿童和青少年提供的免费辅导、作业帮助项目和暑期阅读计划，有助于弥合影响学生学业表现的经济鸿沟。

economic.sentenceEn: Various programs organized by public libraries for children and adolescents help narrow the gap between students from varying economic backgrounds.
economic.translationZh: 公共图书馆为儿童和青少年组织的各类项目有助于缩小不同经济背景学生之间的差距。

economic.sentenceEn: Happiness depends on sustainable economic growth.
economic.translationZh: 幸福取决于可持续的经济增长。

expert.sentenceEn: The slow progress of women in elective office is frustrating for some political observers and experts —including myself.
expert.translationZh: 女性在民选职位上的进展缓慢，这让包括我在内的一些政治观察家和专家感到沮丧。
expert.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

expert.sentenceEn: While B&Bs usually have low initial costs, experts estimate it would take at least five rooms rented regularly for the host to earn a living from B&B.
expert.translationZh: 虽然民宿的初始成本通常较低，但专家估计，房东至少需要定期出租五间客房才能以此维生。
expert.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第8句

expert.sentenceEn: In addition, experts assert that starting younger is better because, if you make a habit of exercising when you are young, you are more likely to keep up those patterns later in life.
expert.translationZh: 此外，专家断言，从年轻时开始运动效果更好，因为如果在年轻时养成锻炼习惯，你更有可能在以后的生活中保持这些模式。
expert.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第6句

expert.sentenceEn: But contrary to all the self-proclaimed success experts , doing it alone does not make you more successful or any better than someone who achieved it with the help of others.
expert.translationZh: 但与那些自封的成功专家所言相反，单打独斗并不会让你比那些在他人帮助下获得成就的人更成功，也不会让你显得更高人一等。
expert.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第5句

expert.sentenceEn: According to an expert in AI and robotics, it may be quite some time before a master robot-chef appears.
expert.translationZh: 一位人工智能与机器人领域的专家表示，要真正实现“机器人主厨”可能还需要相当长的一段时间。

expert.sentenceEn: Success experts often lead people to ruin.
expert.translationZh: 成功学专家往往会将人们引向毁灭。

environmental.sentenceEn: Beyond ensuring that library construction projects consider environmental impact, libraries can take a lead in supporting local foods and craftsmen, like the Peabody Institute Library's partnering with local businesses to pioneer a farmers' market in their courtyard, or the Richmond Public Library's seed lending library which "nurtures locally-adapted plant varieties, and fosters community resilience(韧性), self-reliance and a culture of sharing."
environmental.translationZh: 除了确保图书馆建设项目考虑环境影响外，图书馆还可以带头支持本地食品和手工艺人，例如皮博迪研究所图书馆与当地企业合作，在其庭院开创农贸市场，或者里士满公共图书馆的种子借阅图书馆，该图书馆“培育适应当地的植物品种，培养社区韧性、自力更生和分享文化。”

environmental.sentenceEn: An organized archive is a place where people can research their ancestry and immigration history, do environmental research, and more.
environmental.translationZh: 有组织的档案馆是人们可以研究自己的祖先和移民历史、进行环境研究等活动的地方。

environmental.sentenceEn: According to the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency, the largest sources of U.S. greenhouse gas emissions in 2016 were electricity production (28 percent of total emissions), transportation (28 percent) and industry (22 percent).
environmental.translationZh: 根据美国环境保护署的数据，2016年美国温室气体排放的最大来源是电力生产（占总排放量的28%）、交通运输（28%）和工业（22%）。

environmental.sentenceEn: Climate change demands urgent attention, and the livestock industry has a large overall environmental footprint that affects air, water and land.
environmental.translationZh: 气候变化亟需关注，而畜牧业的整体环境足迹巨大，影响着空气、水和土地。

environmental.sentenceEn: The author doesn't believe giving up meat and meat products will be a cure-all for the environmental problem.
environmental.translationZh: 作者认为放弃肉类及肉制品并非解决环境问题的万能良药。

environmental.sentenceEn: It may change the way of future environmental research.
environmental.translationZh: 这可能会改变未来环境研究的方式。

economy.sentenceEn: Demand for meat is rising in developing and emerging economies , especially in the Middle East, North Africa and Southeast Asia.
economy.translationZh: 发展中经济体和新兴经济体对肉类的需求正在上升，特别是在中东、北非和东南亚地区。

economy.sentenceEn: For example, it's not clear how a 'real wealth' economy would remedy the epidemic of mental ill-health that plagues our society.
economy.translationZh: 例如，目前尚不清楚“真正的财富”经济将如何解决困扰我们社会的精神健康问题流行病。
economy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

economy.sentenceEn: But while a sustainable economy is vital to our future, it is a means to an end, not an end in itself.
economy.translationZh: 然而，尽管可持续经济对我们的未来至关重要，但它终究是一种手段而非目的。
economy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

economy.sentenceEn: As long as the economy is their priority, governments need go no further than ensuring citizens' continued productivity.
economy.translationZh: 只要经济是政府的首要任务，那么确保公民持续的生产力就已足够。
economy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第6句

economy.sentenceEn: What do we see in today's "attention economy " according to Jenny Odell?
economy.translationZh: 根据珍妮·奥德尔（Jenny Odell）的观点，我们在当今的“注意力经济”中看到了什么？

economy.sentenceEn: They tempt users to endorse the attention economy .
economy.translationZh: 它们诱导用户支持注意力经济。

event.sentenceEn: Pesticide use also decreases the life in soil, hampering the ability of soils to absorb carbon or retain water and thus reducing campuses' ability to recover quickly from climate-related extreme weather events like droughts and floods.
event.translationZh: 农药的使用还会减少土壤中的生物活性，削弱土壤吸收碳和保持水分的能力，从而降低校园从干旱和洪水等气候相关极端天气事件中快速恢复的能力。
event.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

event.sentenceEn: Annual summer reading programs also have a positive impact on student performance and, according to a 2010 study conducted by Dominican University's Graduate School of Library and Information Science, students' reading skills get a boost from these popular nationwide events .
event.translationZh: 年度暑期阅读计划对学生表现也有积极影响。根据多米尼加大学图书馆与信息科学研究生院2010年的一项研究，这些在全国范围内广受欢迎的活动有助于提高学生的阅读能力。

event.sentenceEn: Despite the rising costs of concert and theater tickets, public library events (including concerts, author visits, and gallery displays) are often offered free of charge, enabling people of any income level to attend.
event.translationZh: 尽管音乐会和戏剧门票价格不断上涨，但公共图书馆活动（包括音乐会、作家见面会和画廊展览）往往免费提供，使各收入水平的人都能参与。

event.sentenceEn: Have all of your notes and materials organized well in advance of each event , so that all you have to do is grab them and go when it's the actual day.
event.translationZh: 每场活动前都要提前整理好所有笔记和材料，这样到了活动当天，你只需拿起它们就能出发。
event.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

event.sentenceEn: Public libraries organize cultural events , often allowing people of different income levels to attend free of charge.
event.translationZh: 公共图书馆组织文化活动，通常允许不同收入水平的人免费参加。

event.sentenceEn: It triggers our mind to reflect on past experiences or anticipate future events .
event.translationZh: 它会触动我们的思绪，让我们去反思过往的经历，或去憧憬未来的图景。

effective.sentenceEn: Never store foods with high water content here, because the water within them can and will freeze, effectively ruining them.
effective.translationZh: 请勿在此存放高水分含量的食物，因为其中的水分会结冰，从而导致食物变质。
effective.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第7句

effective.sentenceEn: But in branches where employees were more active, introverted(内向的) leaders were more effective .
effective.translationZh: 但在员工更为积极主动的部门中，内向型领导者的工作效率更高。

effective.sentenceEn: Lectures, training programs and workshops can explain the intellectual elements of transformation, but they are seldom effective at getting to the behavioral aspects that lie at the heart of a significant change initiative.
effective.translationZh: 讲座、培训项目和研讨会能够阐释变革的理性要素，但在触及重大变革举措核心的行为层面时，往往收效甚微。
effective.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

effective.sentenceEn: An effective simulation can be better than experience as a learning tool because it accelerates time, compresses space, and unlike reality, is specifically designed to maximize participant learning.
effective.translationZh: 作为一种学习工具，有效的模拟可能比实际经验更优越，因为它能加速时间、压缩空间，而且与现实不同，模拟是专门为最大限度提升参与者学习效果而设计的。
effective.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

effective.sentenceEn: The most effective strategy here is to give yourself a break.
effective.translationZh: 此时最有效的策略是让自己休息一下。

effective.sentenceEn: Schools can boost children's academic performance by effective intervention.
effective.translationZh: 学校可以通过有效的干预措施提高孩子们的学习成绩。

evidence.sentenceEn: Our evidence suggests unexcused absences are problematic, but for a different reason than people often think.
evidence.translationZh: 我们的证据表明，无故缺勤确实是个问题，但其原因与人们通常认为的有所不同。
evidence.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第1句

evidence.sentenceEn: With projects like the Massachussets Memories Road Show and the Veterans History Project, evidence of the importance of archives is everywhere.
evidence.translationZh: 从马萨诸塞记忆巡回展和退伍军人历史项目等计划中可以看出，档案的重要性无处不在。

evidence.sentenceEn: " Evidence suggests that older adults show preserved, and at times enhanced, creativity as a function of enriched memories," the researchers write.
evidence.translationZh: 研究人员写道：“有证据表明，老年人的创造力会因丰富的记忆而保持甚至有时会增强。”
evidence.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

evidence.sentenceEn: There's also evidence that this behavior is socially harmful.
evidence.translationZh: 也有证据表明，这种行为对社会是有害的。
evidence.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

evidence.sentenceEn: What does evidence suggest regarding older adults?
evidence.translationZh: 有哪些证据表明了老年人的相关情况？

evidence.sentenceEn: He has gained ample scientific evidence at the University of Reading.
evidence.translationZh: 他在雷丁大学获得了充分的科学证据。

exist.sentenceEn: In other words, the creature can endure conditions that don't even exist on Earth.
exist.translationZh: 换句话说，这种生物能够忍受地球上根本不存在的环境条件。
exist.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

exist.sentenceEn: The gender pay gap is one of the most outstanding examples of that lack of parity(平等), and still exists just about everywhere.
exist.translationZh: 性别薪酬差距是这种不平等最突出的例子之一，而且几乎在所有地方依然存在。
exist.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

exist.sentenceEn: The true answer to snobbery is not to say that there is no such thing as a better or worse person, but to insist that better or worse exist in constantly unexpected places and carry none of the outward signs of distinction.
exist.translationZh: 真正克服势利的方法，不是否认人与人之间存在优劣之分，而是坚持认为：优劣之别往往出现在最意想不到的地方，且从不带有任何外在的区分标志。
exist.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第1句

exist.sentenceEn: But, says Chomka, such technology could miss the mark if it only offers "solutions to problems that don't really exist ".
exist.translationZh: 但乔姆卡表示，如果这类技术仅仅是在为“并不真正存在的问题提供解决方案”，那么它可能会偏离目标。

exist.sentenceEn: What does Professor Tom Oliver think of the idea that we exist as independent selves at the centre of a subjective universe?
exist.translationZh: 汤姆·奥利弗教授如何看待我们作为独立自我存在于主观宇宙中心这一观点？

exist.sentenceEn: Women are encouraged to pursue a beauty ideal that has never existed .
exist.translationZh: 女性被鼓励去追求一种从未存在过的 beauty 理想。

emission.sentenceEn: The use of chemicals to get rid of insects or unwanted plant life can increase indirect emissions as they can include petroleum-based ingredients.
emission.translationZh: 使用化学物质清除昆虫或多余植物可能会增加间接排放，因为这些化学物质可能含有石油基成分。
emission.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

emission.sentenceEn: This included emissions from fertilizer production, converting land from forests to pastures, growing feed, and direct emissions from animals (manure as well as expelling of gas from the stomach) from birth to death.
emission.translationZh: 这包括化肥生产的排放、将森林土地转为牧场的排放、饲料种植的排放，以及动物从出生到死亡期间的直接排放（包括粪便和肠胃排气）。

emission.sentenceEn: However, as Stenfeld has pointed out, direct emissions from transportation versus livestock can be compared and amount to 14 versus 5 percent, respectively.
emission.translationZh: 然而，正如Stenfeld所指出的，交通与畜牧业的直接排放量可以进行比较，分别为14%和5%。

emission.sentenceEn: According to the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency, the largest sources of U.S. greenhouse gas emissions in 2016 were electricity production (28 percent of total emissions ), transportation (28 percent) and industry (22 percent).
emission.translationZh: 根据美国环境保护署的数据，2016年美国温室气体排放的最大来源是电力生产（占总排放量的28%）、交通运输（28%）和工业（22%）。

emission.sentenceEn: Unfortunately, the agency's initial claim that livestock was responsible for the lion's share of world greenhouse gas emissions had already received wide coverage.
emission.translationZh: 不幸的是，该机构最初声称畜牧业是全球温室气体排放的主要来源，这一说法已得到广泛报道。

emission.sentenceEn: Changes in America's farming technology and management in the past decades have increased efficiency and reduced greenhouse gas emissions in meat production.
emission.translationZh: 过去几十年，美国农业技术和管理的变革提高了肉类生产的效率，同时减少了温室气体排放。

enable.sentenceEn: Despite the rising costs of concert and theater tickets, public library events (including concerts, author visits, and gallery displays) are often offered free of charge, enabling people of any income level to attend.
enable.translationZh: 尽管音乐会和戏剧门票价格不断上涨，但公共图书馆活动（包括音乐会、作家见面会和画廊展览）往往免费提供，使各收入水平的人都能参与。

enable.sentenceEn: Access is key: people do not need to own, but rather access things that enable them to live well.
enable.translationZh: 使用权是关键：人们不需要拥有物品，而是需要获得那些能让他们生活得更好的东西。
enable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

enable.sentenceEn: To create this kind of widespread passion, learning leaders must expose the workforce to what could be, which will enable them to rethink their mental models, enable them to break free from their deep-rooted paradigms and embrace the opportunity to learn.
enable.translationZh: 为了培养这种广泛的热情，学习型领导者必须让员工接触未来的可能性，这将使他们能够重新思考自己的思维模式，摆脱根深蒂固的固有观念，并拥抱学习的机会。
enable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

enable.sentenceEn: Well-designed simulations can enable individuals and groups to develop a deep level of understanding about how their decisions and intuitive responses to business stimuli affect their fellow participants and the organization as a whole.
enable.translationZh: 精心设计的模拟能够让个人和团队深入理解他们的决策以及对业务刺激的直觉反应如何影响其他参与者和整个组织。
enable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

enable.sentenceEn: Being alone enables artists to think and observe, which is a must for their creation.
enable.translationZh: 独处能让艺术家思考和观察，这是他们创作的必要条件。

enable.sentenceEn: They enable customers to eat in a healthy way.
enable.translationZh: 它们能让顾客吃得更健康。

engage.sentenceEn: When shrinking municipal budgets combine with the nonstop technological revolution, public library services that focus on building communities face-to-face, inspiring and educating patrons about art, literature, and music, and helping patrons engage in civil discourse can seem old-fashioned.
engage.translationZh: 当不断缩减的市政预算遇上永不停歇的技术革命，那些专注于面对面社区建设、启发和教育读者了解艺术、文学和音乐，以及帮助读者参与公民对话的公共图书馆服务，似乎显得有些过时了。

engage.sentenceEn: The decline of civil discourse stems in part from the fact that it is so easy for people to watch news about, buy products from, and engage —in both the virtual and real worlds—only with those of similar backgrounds and ideologies.
engage.translationZh: 公民话语的衰落，部分源于人们可以轻易地只关注与自己背景和意识形态相似者的新闻、购买他们的产品，并在虚拟和现实世界中仅与这类人互动。

engage.sentenceEn: As community builders libraries are engaged in incredible work.
engage.translationZh: 作为社区建设者，图书馆正在从事着令人赞叹的工作。

engage.sentenceEn: There are surely endless examples of innovative library services for children, including the Middle Country Public Library's Nature Explorium, which engages children in learning about the natural world.
engage.translationZh: 针对儿童的创新图书馆服务无疑有无数例证，其中包括中郡公共图书馆的“自然探索馆”，该馆让孩子们参与到自然世界的学习中。

engage.sentenceEn: When meetings continue too long or don't engage employees, they deplete vitality.
engage.translationZh: 当会议持续时间过长或无法让员工参与时，就会消耗活力。

engage.sentenceEn: They are engaged in research on a remote-controlled robot which uses special power.

email.sentenceEn: For example, if you want to stop checking your email first thing in the morning, you might decide to substitute another activity in its place.

email.sentenceEn: If all that's on the agenda is a quick catch-up, or some non-urgent information sharing, it may better suit the group to send around an email instead.

emotional.sentenceEn: Setting a boundary in this regard, if you feel you need one, is perfectly reasonable and something that can bring you increased emotional safety.
emotional.translationZh: 在这方面，如果你觉得有必要，设定一个界限是完全合理的，这能为你带来更多的心理安全感。

emotional.sentenceEn: These people may also display a problematic degree of emotional vulnerability, becoming upset very quickly, and taking a long time to calm down.

ecosystem.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

ecosystem.sentenceEn: These included measures to reduce air pollution; to control the damage to marine ecosystems , which can have a huge effect on fish stocks on which hundreds of millions of people depend; and to curb the degradation of land where modern agricultural methods were pursued without regard to the longer-term consequences.

effectively.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

effectively.sentenceEn: How to respond effectively to climate change has become the focus of international diplomacy.
effectively.translationZh: 如何有效应对气候变化已成为国际外交的焦点议题。

effectively.sentenceEn: They cope with the outside world more effectively than their animal relatives.
effectively.translationZh: 他们比自己的动物近亲更能有效地应对外部世界。

electronic.sentenceEn: And the children who read the electronic books learned more.
electronic.translationZh: 而那些阅读电子书的孩子们学到了更多。
electronic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第5句

electronic.sentenceEn: Previous studies of young children have suggested that electronic books, which incorporate extra features such as dictionaries and images that depict story events, may have advantages over print.
electronic.translationZh: 针对幼儿的既往研究表明，电子书整合了词典、故事场景配图等额外功能，可能比纸质书更具优势。
electronic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

electronic.sentenceEn: Each parent-child pair was randomly assigned to read either two educational electronic books or two printed books with the same content.
electronic.translationZh: 每对家长和孩子被随机分配阅读两本电子教育书籍，或两本内容相同的纸质书。
electronic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

electronic.sentenceEn: Extra features in electronic books may increase children's participation with them; however, if these features don't draw attention to the educational content, they may not serve as a supportive feature.
electronic.translationZh: 电子书中的额外功能可能会增加儿童的参与度；然而，如果这些功能无法引导儿童关注教育内容，它们可能无法起到辅助作用。
electronic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

electronic.sentenceEn: What do we learn about previous studies of young children reading electronic books?
electronic.translationZh: 关于以往对幼儿阅读电子书的研究，我们了解到了什么？

electronic.sentenceEn: Both parents and children preferred to read electronic books.
electronic.translationZh: 父母和孩子都更喜欢阅读电子书。

establish.sentenceEn: The WHO recommends establishing institutions that facilitate community participation—educational programs and interventions that provide skills for promoting mental wellbeing.
establish.translationZh: 世界卫生组织建议建立促进社区参与的机构——提供促进心理健康技能的教育项目和干预措施。
establish.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第4句

establish.sentenceEn: It looks like the government of Winopia seems to be undergoing some sort of crisis of legitimacy, and an interim administration has been transitionally established until a head of state is agreed on.
establish.translationZh: 维诺比亚政府似乎正在经历某种合法性危机，目前已成立临时内阁，直到就国家元首人选达成一致为止。
establish.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

establish.sentenceEn: There's a habit that many perfectionists tend to fall into when they try to establish a behavior change.
establish.translationZh: 许多完美主义者在尝试改变行为时，往往会陷入一种习惯。

establish.sentenceEn: And it is well established that personality traits differ between countries.
establish.translationZh: 而且，国家之间的人格特质存在差异，这已是公认的事实。
establish.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

establish.sentenceEn: San Francisco city government offered tax benefits to attract tech companies to establish operations in a less developed area.
establish.translationZh: 旧金山市政府提供税收优惠，吸引科技公司在欠发达地区开展业务。

establish.sentenceEn: They have conclusively established the criteria of animal intelligence.
establish.translationZh: 他们已经为动物智能确立了确凿的标准。

extinction.sentenceEn: We are in the midst of the sixth great extinction event of life on our planet, which not only threatens wildlife species, but also imperils the global food supply.
extinction.translationZh: 我们正处于地球生命的第六次大灭绝事件之中，这不仅威胁着野生物种，也危及全球粮食供应。
extinction.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

extinction.sentenceEn: About 23,000 of 80,000 species surveyed are approaching extinction .
extinction.translationZh: 在接受调查的80,000个物种中，约有23,000个正濒临灭绝。
extinction.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

extinction.sentenceEn: The genetic code of all 1.5 million known species of animals and plants living on earth will be mapped to help save species from extinction and boost human health.
extinction.translationZh: 地球上所有150万种已知动植物的遗传密码将被绘制出来，以帮助拯救物种免于灭绝并促进人类健康。
extinction.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

extinction.sentenceEn: Many scientists believe that earth has now entered the sixth mass extinction , with humans creating a toxic mix of habitat loss, pollution and climate change, which has already led to the loss of at least 77 species of mammals and 140 types of birds since 1500.
extinction.translationZh: 许多科学家认为地球现已进入第六次大规模灭绝时期，人类造成的栖息地丧失、污染和气候变化等不利因素相互交织，自1500年以来已导致至少77种哺乳动物和140种鸟类灭绝。
extinction.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

extinction.sentenceEn: Professor Bostrom, who directs Oxford's Future of Humanity Institute, has argued over the course of several papers that human extinction risks are poorly understood and, worse still, severely underestimated by society.
extinction.translationZh: 博斯特罗姆教授是牛津大学人类未来研究所的所长，他在多篇论文中指出，人类对灭绝风险的理解不足，更糟糕的是，社会严重低估了这些风险。
extinction.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

extinction.sentenceEn: Find out the cause of extinction of Britain's 66, 000 species.
extinction.translationZh: 找出英国66,000个物种灭绝的原因。

expand.sentenceEn: In an age where career progression may lead us into new sectors it is ever more important to challenge our sense of self and explore whether you can create a new experience of your identity by changing the beliefs you hold about yourself in order to expand your career options.
expand.translationZh: 在职业生涯可能引领我们进入新领域的时代，挑战自我认知并探索能否通过改变对自己的固有信念来创造新的身份体验，从而拓展职业选择，这一点变得愈发重要。
expand.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第6句

expand.sentenceEn: But he wouldn't really expand on that description.
expand.translationZh: 但他并没有详细解释这个说法。
expand.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

expand.sentenceEn: Institutions and researchers should invest in partnerships that expand capacity for sharing results more broadly.
expand.translationZh: 科研机构和研究人员应投资建立合作伙伴关系，以扩大更广泛地分享研究成果的能力。
expand.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第2句

expand.sentenceEn: In its long history, it has never been expanded , remaining as a single loop line with a mere 15 stations.
expand.translationZh: 在其悠久的历史中，地铁从未进行过扩建，始终保持着单环线的格局，仅有15个车站。
expand.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

expand.sentenceEn: What should we do to expand our career options?
expand.translationZh: 我们应该如何拓展自己的职业选择？

expand.sentenceEn: It is expanding at an accelerating speed.

elite.sentenceEn: Unfortunately, it has come to my attention that I am not an elite sleeper after all.
elite.translationZh: 遗憾的是，我现在意识到自己终究不是那种睡眠质量超群的人。
elite.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

elite.sentenceEn: I don't want to boast or anything, but I have always considered myself something of an elite sleeper.
elite.translationZh: 我不是想吹嘘什么，但我一直认为自己算得上是个睡眠高手。
elite.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

elite.sentenceEn: It seems I am just lazy, because elite sleepers are defined as the approximately 3 percent of the population who are biologically programmed to need less sleep than the rest of us.
elite.translationZh: 看来我只是懒而已，因为精英睡眠者被定义为大约3%的人群，他们的生理结构决定了他们比我们其他人需要更少的睡眠。
elite.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

elite.sentenceEn: Is there a non-biological way to reach elite sleeper status?
elite.translationZh: 有没有非生物学的方法达到精英睡眠者状态？
elite.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

elite.sentenceEn: What do we learn from the passage about elite sleepers?
elite.translationZh: 从文章中我们能了解到关于精英睡眠者的哪些信息？

elite.sentenceEn: They have been constantly attacked for being too elite and too expensive.
elite.translationZh: 这些院校一直因过于精英化且费用过高而备受抨击。

estimate.sentenceEn: In its most recent assessment report, the FAO estimated that livestock produces 14.5 percent of global greenhouse gas emissions from human activities.
estimate.translationZh: 联合国粮农组织（FAO）在其最新评估报告中估计，畜牧业产生的温室气体排放量占人类活动总排放量的14.5%。

estimate.sentenceEn: While B&Bs usually have low initial costs, experts estimate it would take at least five rooms rented regularly for the host to earn a living from B&B.
estimate.translationZh: 虽然民宿的初始成本通常较低，但专家估计，房东至少需要定期出租五间客房才能以此维生。
estimate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第8句

estimate.sentenceEn: It is estimated that pollution is linked to over 40,000 early deaths in Britain each year.
estimate.translationZh: 据估计，英国每年有超过 4 万人的早逝与污染问题有关。
estimate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

estimate.sentenceEn: By 2050 it estimates the world must produce 50% more food to feed the projected global population of 10 billion.
estimate.translationZh: 据估计，到2050年，为了养活预计达到100亿的全球人口，世界必须多生产50%的粮食。

estimate.sentenceEn: According to estimates , the number of people who speak two languages or more is greater than those who speak one language only.
estimate.translationZh: 据估计，会说两种或两种以上语言的人数多于只会说一种语言的人。

estimate.sentenceEn: It is estimated to be about $40,000 a month.
estimate.translationZh: 据估计，每月约有4万美元。

entire.sentenceEn: A key claim underlying these arguments holds that globally, meat production generates more greenhouse gases than the entire transportation sector.
entire.translationZh: 这些论点的一个核心主张认为，在全球范围内，肉类生产产生的温室气体比整个交通运输部门还要多。

entire.sentenceEn: You'll see, the entire managerial hierarchy wants to see this project implemented as soon as possible, and the board, too, is virtually unanimous in its support.
entire.translationZh: 你会发现，整个管理层都希望这个项目能尽快落地，而且董事会也几乎一致表示支持。
entire.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第14段，第3句

entire.sentenceEn: Like the entire building is beautiful.
entire.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第2句

entire.sentenceEn: The deed read, "W. H. Jackson for and in consideration of the great affection which he bears the said tree, and his great desire to see it protected has conveyed unto the said oak tree entire possession of itself and of all land within eight feet of it on all sides."
entire.translationZh: 地契上写道：'W·H·杰克逊出于对上述橡树的深厚感情，以及他渴望看到其得到保护的强烈愿望，特将该橡树本身及其四周各八英尺范围内所有土地的完整所有权，转让给上述橡树。'

entire.sentenceEn: What does the entire managerial hierarchy want to see according to the woman?
entire.translationZh: 根据这位女士的说法，整个管理层希望看到什么？

entire.sentenceEn: She slept during the entire ride.

ecological.sentenceEn: Instead, people cope with challenging climates and ecological contexts by carefully copying others.
ecological.translationZh: 相反，人类通过仔细模仿他人来应对具有挑战性的气候和生态环境。
ecological.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

ecological.sentenceEn: Does this perhaps explain, in part, the lack of data about how spiders are faring in our age of ecological crisis?
ecological.translationZh: 这是否在一定程度上解释了，在我们这个生态危机的时代，为何缺乏关于蜘蛛生存状况的数据？
ecological.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

ecological.sentenceEn: The rise of the idea of the environment and a scholarly understanding of ecological processes has influenced new technologies and also politics.
ecological.translationZh: 环境理念的兴起以及对生态过程的学术理解，已经影响了新技术的发展，也影响了政治格局。

ecological.sentenceEn: If the ever-faster exhaustion of natural resources (in ecological terms) and the "shrinking of the present" (in social terms) are urgent problems of humans, then cutting down on exhaustive practices and working towards a "stretching of the present" will be ways to move forward.
ecological.translationZh: 如果说自然资源的加速枯竭（从生态角度而言）与“当下的萎缩”（从社会角度而言）是人类面临的紧迫问题，那么减少耗竭性实践并致力于“延展当下”将是我们前进的道路。

ecological.sentenceEn: Things cannot change overnight, but reducing the consumption of natural resources will help solve the ecological crisis.
ecological.translationZh: 事情不可能一蹴而就，但减少自然资源消耗将有助于解决生态危机。

ecological.sentenceEn: They are naturally adaptive to ecological contexts.
ecological.translationZh: 它们天生就能适应生态环境。

efficiency.sentenceEn: These, combined with a rapidly rising world population, give us plenty of compelling reasons to continue to work for greater efficiencies in animal agriculture.
efficiency.translationZh: 这些因素，再加上世界人口的迅速增长，为我们继续致力于提高畜牧业效率提供了充分的有力理由。

efficiency.sentenceEn: With its links to organisational efficiency and employee wellbeing, MRS has attracted the attention of psychologists aware of the need to understand its precise causes and cures.
efficiency.translationZh: 由于与组织效率和员工福祉息息相关，管理退缩综合征（MRS）引起了心理学家的关注，他们意识到有必要了解其确切成因和解决方法。

efficiency.sentenceEn: We may be piled up like boxes in the city, but this brings energy efficiency that the countryside cannot match.
efficiency.translationZh: 我们或许像城市里堆叠的盒子一样居住密集，但这带来了乡村无法比拟的能源效率。
efficiency.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

efficiency.sentenceEn: W: So far, so good, I don't miss having managers who deliver blunt, harsh feedback in the name of efficiency .
efficiency.translationZh: 女：目前来说还不错。我可不怀念那些以效率为名，给出生硬、刺耳反馈的经理们。
efficiency.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

efficiency.sentenceEn: Changes in America's farming technology and management in the past decades have increased efficiency and reduced greenhouse gas emissions in meat production.
efficiency.translationZh: 过去几十年，美国农业技术和管理的变革提高了肉类生产的效率，同时减少了温室气体排放。

efficiency.sentenceEn: They reject employees' reasonable arguments for work efficiency .
efficiency.translationZh: 他们拒绝听取员工提出的关于提高工作效率的合理主张。

extra.sentenceEn: Anticipate that by giving yourself extra time to arrive.
extra.translationZh: 预计一下，给自己留出额外的到达时间。
extra.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

extra.sentenceEn: Personalisation is seen as key to the appeal of this technology, alongside its ability to reliably push so-called "upsells" (meal deals, extras , larger drinks) to customers.
extra.translationZh: 个性化被视为这项技术的吸引力核心，同时它还能可靠地向客户推送所谓的“追加销售”（如套餐、加餐、大杯饮料）。

extra.sentenceEn: Extra features in electronic books may increase children's participation with them; however, if these features don't draw attention to the educational content, they may not serve as a supportive feature.
extra.translationZh: 电子书中的额外功能可能会增加儿童的参与度；然而，如果这些功能无法引导儿童关注教育内容，它们可能无法起到辅助作用。
extra.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

extra.sentenceEn: Previous studies of young children have suggested that electronic books, which incorporate extra features such as dictionaries and images that depict story events, may have advantages over print.
extra.translationZh: 针对幼儿的既往研究表明，电子书整合了词典、故事场景配图等额外功能，可能比纸质书更具优势。
extra.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

extra.sentenceEn: What extra features should be included in electronic books to bolster children's learning?
extra.translationZh: 为了加强儿童学习，电子书还应增加哪些额外功能？

extra.sentenceEn: Workers have to take extra caution executing their duties.
extra.translationZh: 工人们在执行任务时必须格外小心。

emerge.sentenceEn: "These days, we tend to believe that creativity emerges from a decidedly unreserved socialising process, but in fact it requires sustained attention and deep focus," she says.
emerge.translationZh: 她说：“如今，我们往往认为创造力源于一种毫无保留的社交过程，但实际上它需要持续的专注和深度的投入。”

emerge.sentenceEn: For those of us who just prefer plenty of alone time, emerging research suggests some good news: there are upsides to being alone—for both our work lives and our emotional well-being.
emerge.translationZh: 对于我们中那些更喜欢拥有大量独处时间的人来说，最新研究带来了好消息：独处对我们的工作生活和情绪健康都有好处。

emerge.sentenceEn: We know that the world is going to see new cities emerging from the dust and current cities growing into megacities, but the future of the countryside is less clear.
emerge.translationZh: 我们知道，世界将见证新兴城市拔地而起，现有城市发展为特大城市，但农村的未来却不那么清晰。
emerge.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第3句

emerge.sentenceEn: At the end, write down any emerging ideas.
emerge.translationZh: 最后，写下任何浮现的想法。
emerge.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第6句

emerge.sentenceEn: Many psychologists, child development experts and educators point to research suggesting that this emerging cradle-to-grave consumerism is contributing to growing rates of low self-esteem, depression and other forms of mental illness.
emerge.translationZh: 许多心理学家、儿童发展专家和教育工作者指出，研究表明这种新兴的“从摇篮到坟墓”的消费主义正在导致儿童自尊心低下、抑郁症和其他形式精神疾病的发生率不断上升。
emerge.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

enhance.sentenceEn: In terms of simplifying or enhancing the customer experience, online restaurant booking has been the easily-won success of the internet age.
enhance.translationZh: 在简化或提升客户体验方面，在线餐厅预订已成为互联网时代最容易取得成功的典范。

enhance.sentenceEn: In other words, practicing a letter-detection task will, over time, improve your letter-detection skills, but it will not necessarily enhance your other perceptual abilities.
enhance.translationZh: 换句话说，练习字母识别任务会随着时间的推移提高你的字母识别技能，但这不一定能增强你的其他感知能力。

enhance.sentenceEn: Research is meant to benefit society by raising public awareness and creating products and innovations that enhance development.
enhance.translationZh: 研究旨在通过提高公众意识、创造促进发展的产品和创新来造福社会。
enhance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

enhance.sentenceEn: Beyond the virtue of access to those who have earned a place at these schools, the diversity of economic backgrounds enhances the education and experience of all of our students.
enhance.translationZh: 除了为那些凭实力考入这些学校的学生提供受教育机会这一益处外，经济背景的多样性还能增进所有学生的教育体验。
enhance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

enhance.sentenceEn: Gratitude is likely to enhance one's sense of being connected with other people.
enhance.translationZh: 感恩有助于增强一个人与他人的联结感。

eventually.sentenceEn: Father time comes for us all eventually , even our often long lived, tall and leafy fellow custodians(看管者) of Earth.
eventually.translationZh: 时光老人终将降临在我们每个人身上，即便是那些寿命悠长、高大繁茂的地球守护者亦是如此。

eventually.sentenceEn: Eventually , the lights come up and the rectangular screen goes black.
eventually.translationZh: 最终，灯光亮起，矩形屏幕变为黑色。
eventually.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

eventually.sentenceEn: Coffee can also increase blood sugar and eventually cause lack of focus and energy.
eventually.translationZh: 咖啡还会升高血糖，最终导致注意力不集中和精力不足。
eventually.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

eventually.sentenceEn: Eventually those billions and billions of birds shrank to a single remaining specimen, a passenger pigeon named Martha, who died on September 1,1914, in captivity at the Cincinnati Zoo.
eventually.translationZh: 最终，那数十亿只旅鸽凋零至仅剩最后一只——一只名叫玛莎的旅鸽，它于1914年9月1日在辛辛那提动物园的笼中离世。
eventually.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

eventually.sentenceEn: Eventually , it becomes a question in consumers' minds: Were these foods ever safe?
eventually.translationZh: 最终，消费者心中会产生这样一个疑问：这些食品曾经安全吗？
eventually.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

eventually.sentenceEn: It may eventually lose its freshness and appeal.
eventually.translationZh: 它最终可能会失去新鲜感和吸引力。

executive.sentenceEn: Two talented young executives , one of whom I was managing, had vastly different accounts of the same event, and it seemed likely we'd never get to the truth.
executive.translationZh: 两位年轻有为的高管对同一事件的描述截然不同，其中一位还是我的下属。看来我们可能永远无法查明真相了。
executive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第5句

executive.sentenceEn: As an executive coach, I work with numerous passionate and hard-working leaders who don't want to "quit".
executive.translationZh: 作为一名高管教练，我与许多充满激情、工作勤奋但并不想“离职”的领导者一起工作。

executive.sentenceEn: "You can't sprinkle in a little phonics," says Tenette Smith, executive director of elementary education and reading at Mississippi's education department.

emphasize.translationZh: 机智的言辞通常是对他人无益言论或行为的回应，其目的是通过强调问题的荒谬之处来理清和阐明问题。
emphasize.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第3句

emphasize.sentenceEn: To the teacher who is a proficient reader, literacy seems like a natural process that requires educated guessing, rather than the deliberate process emphasized by phonics.
emphasize.translationZh: 对于精通阅读的教师而言，识字似乎是一个需要有根据猜测的自然过程，而非自然拼读法所强调的刻意过程。
emphasize.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

emphasize.sentenceEn: Instead of praises like "You're so smart," parents and educators should say things like "You really stuck with it," Pryor says, to emphasize the value of perseverance over intrinsic talent.
emphasize.translationZh: 普赖尔说，父母和教育者不应说“你真聪明”这类表扬，而应说“你真有毅力”，以此强调坚持不懈的价值高于内在天赋。

emphasize.sentenceEn: It is equally imperative to emphasize that being an expert on a topic does not automatically make a scholar qualified to communicate it to a nonscientific audience.
emphasize.translationZh: 同样必须强调的是，成为某一领域的专家并不自动意味着这位学者就有资格向非科学受众传播该领域知识。
emphasize.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

emphasize.sentenceEn: What does the author want to emphasize at the end of the passage regarding Americans' obsession with looks?
emphasize.translationZh: 在文章结尾，作者想就美国人对外表的痴迷强调什么？

emphasize.sentenceEn: He believed writers should emphasize the positive aspects of life.
emphasize.translationZh: 他认为作家应该强调生活的积极面。

encounter.sentenceEn: For almost a decade, I told everyone I encountered that they should do the same.
encounter.translationZh: 近十年来，我告诉遇到的每一个人，他们也应该这样做。
encounter.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

encounter.sentenceEn: The twist is that this exclusion occurs while sharing a physical encounter and having a conversation.
encounter.translationZh: 出人意料的是，这种排斥恰恰发生在双方进行身体接触和面对面交谈的过程中。
encounter.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

encounter.sentenceEn: Imagine this scenario—a person is walking down the street smelling a scent that they first encountered decades ago, which activates an emotional response.
encounter.translationZh: 想象这样一个场景：一个人走在街上，闻到了几十年前首次闻到的一种气味，这引发了一种情感反应。
encounter.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第7句

encounter.sentenceEn: What follows is my conversation with Bostrom about some of the most interesting and worrying existential risks that humanity might encounter in the decades and centuries to come, and about what we can do to make sure we outlast them.
encounter.translationZh: 以下是我与博斯特罗姆的对话，内容涉及人类在未来数十年乃至数百年可能面临的一些最引人关注且令人担忧的生存风险，以及我们可以采取哪些措施确保能够挺过这些风险。
encounter.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

encounter.sentenceEn: What was the problem Jenny Weiner encountered four years ago?
encounter.translationZh: 四年前詹妮·韦纳遇到了什么问题？

encounter.sentenceEn: They will encounter some degree of difficulty.
encounter.translationZh: 他们会遇到一定程度的困难。

exchange.sentenceEn: The researchers also calculated the clean air delivery rate for plants in the studies they analyzed and found that the rate at which plants disperse the compounds was well below the usual rate of air exchange in a normal building, caused by the movement of people coming and going, opening doors and windows.
exchange.translationZh: 研究人员还计算了他们所分析研究中植物的洁净空气输送率，发现植物驱散化合物的速率远低于普通建筑物中通常的空气交换率，后者是由人员往来、门窗开关等活动引起的。
exchange.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

exchange.sentenceEn: "Our findings suggest the importance of parents finding opportunities to foster conversational exchanges in daily routines with their young children—including while watching television," Shah said.
exchange.translationZh: 沙阿表示：“我们的研究结果表明，父母在日常生活中——包括看电视时——寻找机会与年幼子女促进对话交流非常重要。”
exchange.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

exchange.sentenceEn: No relationship has to be built before an exchange can take place.
exchange.translationZh: 交流发生前不一定需要先建立关系。

exchange.sentenceEn: Although it can generate foreign exchange , income and employment, there's no guarantee that multinational hotel chains will allocate these benefits equitably among local communities.
exchange.translationZh: 尽管旅游业能够创造外汇收入、提供就业机会，但无法保证跨国酒店连锁企业会在当地社区间公平分配这些利益。
exchange.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

exchange.sentenceEn: In one of his last public speeches, a radio broadcast to the United States in March 1937, he deplored that broadcasting had become a one-way means of communication and foresaw it moving in another direction, toward communication as a means of exchange .
exchange.translationZh: 1937年3月，在他最后一次公开演讲中——这是一场向美国的无线电广播——他对广播已沦为单向通信手段表示痛惜，并预见它将转向另一个方向，即成为一种交流工具。

exchange.sentenceEn: The Indian rupee has been steady on the foreign exchange market.
exchange.translationZh: 印度卢比在外汇市场上一直保持稳定。

exposure.sentenceEn: "For example, face recognition is affected by whether people grew up in a small community or in a larger community. Exposure to fewer faces during childhood is associated with diminished face memory."
exposure.translationZh: 例如，人脸识别会受到人们成长于小社区还是大社区的影响。童年时期接触的面孔较少与面孔记忆力下降有关。
exposure.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第10段，第2句

exposure.sentenceEn: Researchers assessed hours of daily television exposure and frequency of parent-screen-time conversation among 1,500 preschoolers, and then measured early childhood curiosity in kindergarten.
exposure.translationZh: 研究人员评估了1500名学龄前儿童的每日电视接触时长和父母-屏幕时间对话频率，随后测量了这些儿童在幼儿园时期的早期好奇心。
exposure.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

exposure.sentenceEn: Excessive media exposure , including television, can displace exploratory activities such as play and parent-child interactions, which are believed to be key to cultivating curiosity in kids.
exposure.translationZh: 过度的媒体曝光，包括看电视，会挤占探索性活动的时间，如玩耍和亲子互动，而这些活动被认为是培养孩子好奇心的关键。
exposure.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

exposure.sentenceEn: While many young children are now growing up with digital media exposure through mobile devices like tablets and phones, television remains a dominant screen activity, accounting for 72% of all screen time.
exposure.translationZh: 尽管现在许多幼儿通过平板电脑和手机等移动设备接触数字媒体长大，但电视仍是主要的屏幕活动，占所有屏幕时间的72%。
exposure.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

exposure.sentenceEn: What does the passage say about excessive media exposure ?
exposure.translationZh: 这篇文章对过度媒体曝光有何论述？

exposure.sentenceEn: Their daily television exposure cuts parent-child conversation time.
exposure.translationZh: 他们每天看电视的时间减少了亲子交谈时间。

efficient.sentenceEn: Moreover, technological, genetic and management changes that have taken place in U.S. agriculture over the past 70 years have made livestock production more efficient and less greenhouse gas-intensive.
efficient.translationZh: 此外，过去70年来美国农业在技术、基因和管理方面发生的变革，提高了 livestock 生产的效率，同时降低了其温室气体密集度。

efficient.sentenceEn: Technological advances and changes in social behavior enable us to make more efficient use of the assets that we already have.
efficient.translationZh: 技术进步和社会行为变化使我们能够更高效地利用已有的资源。
efficient.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

efficient.sentenceEn: The space agency was primarily concerned about keeping the air fresh for astronauts cut off in biospheres or space stations and helping to combat "sick building syndrome", which had become a problem due to the super insulated and energy efficient offices of the late 1970s.
efficient.translationZh: 航天局最初主要关注的是为与世隔绝的生物圈或空间站中的宇航员保持空气清新，以及帮助解决20世纪70年代末因超隔热、节能办公室而出现的"病态建筑综合症"问题。
efficient.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

efficient.sentenceEn: The predictions are going to get better and better, and they will ultimately make common experiences more efficient and pleasant.
efficient.translationZh: 这些预测将会变得越来越精准，最终使日常体验更加高效和愉悦。
efficient.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

efficient.sentenceEn: So workplace surveillance could be empowering for staff and useful for companies looking to become more efficient and profitable.
efficient.translationZh: 因此，工作场所监控既可以增强员工的能力，也有助于企业提高效率和盈利能力。
efficient.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

efficient.sentenceEn: Natural ventilation proves much more efficient for cleaning the air than houseplants.
efficient.translationZh: 事实证明，自然通风净化空气的效率比室内植物高得多。

elderly.sentenceEn: New moms connect at baby story-times; elderly people, often facing difficult life transitions, attend events and find that they make new friends; teenagers meet up in libraries' teen spaces after school; and readers discuss current events in the periodicals room.
elderly.translationZh: 新手妈妈们通过婴儿故事会相互结识；老年人往往面临艰难的人生转折，他们参加活动并发现自己交到了新朋友；青少年放学后在图书馆的青少年专区相聚；读者们则在期刊阅览室讨论时事。

elderly.sentenceEn: These are the central problems to questions of charity though charity also includes many other areas such as assisting the elderly .
elderly.translationZh: 这些是慈善问题的核心，但慈善也包括许多其他领域，如帮助老年人。
elderly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

elderly.sentenceEn: Loneliness and social isolation are growing public health concerns for people of all ages in the United States, from adolescence to the elderly .
elderly.translationZh: 在美国，从青少年到老年人，孤独和社交隔离正成为各个年龄段人群日益严重的公共健康问题。
elderly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

elderly.sentenceEn: W: Well, all the neighbours are elderly , so no noisy kids.
elderly.translationZh: 房东太太：是这样的，邻居们都上了年纪，所以不会有吵闹的小孩。
elderly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

elderly.sentenceEn: Lots of research demonstrates that being socially isolated is harmful to the elderly .
elderly.translationZh: 大量研究表明，社交孤立对老年人有害。

elderly.sentenceEn: Improved health care for the elderly will contribute to longevity.
elderly.translationZh: 改善老年人的医疗保健将有助于延长寿命。

electricity.sentenceEn: According to the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency, the largest sources of U.S. greenhouse gas emissions in 2016 were electricity production (28 percent of total emissions), transportation (28 percent) and industry (22 percent).
electricity.translationZh: 根据美国环境保护署的数据，2016年美国温室气体排放的最大来源是电力生产（占总排放量的28%）、交通运输（28%）和工业（22%）。

electricity.sentenceEn: Wind and solar power generation has increased over 400% since 2010, and renewables provided 46% of the country's electricity in 2019.
electricity.translationZh: 自2010年以来，风能和太阳能发电量增长了400%以上，2019年可再生能源占全国电力供应的46%。
electricity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第3句

electricity.sentenceEn: The instability of renewables doesn't just mean energy is often not produced at night, but also that solar and wind can overwhelm the grid during the day, forcing utilities to pay customers to use their electricity .
electricity.translationZh: 可再生能源的不稳定性不仅意味着夜晚往往无法产生能源，还意味着白天太阳能和风能可能会使电网不堪重负，迫使电力公司不得不付费让用户用电。
electricity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第2句

electricity.sentenceEn: Founded by the electricity tycoon(大亨) L.L. Nunn in 1917, Deep Springs "curriculum" revolves around academics, labor, and self-governance.
electricity.translationZh: 深泉学院由电力大亨L.L.纳恩于1917年创立，其“课程”围绕学术、劳动和自治三大核心展开。

electricity.sentenceEn: And 300,000 more people gained access to electricity each day.
electricity.translationZh: 而且每天新增30万人用上了电。
electricity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

electricity.sentenceEn: It relies on renewable energy to generate more than half of its electricity .
electricity.translationZh: 它依靠可再生能源生产超过一半的电力。

exotic.sentenceEn: But others are obscure or even exotic .
exotic.translationZh: 但另一些则晦涩难懂，甚至离奇古怪。
exotic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

exotic.sentenceEn: M: You certainly get to travel to some very exotic locations.
exotic.translationZh: 您确实去过一些非常具有异域风情的地方。
exotic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

exotic.sentenceEn: Home to virgin reefs, rare sharks and vast numbers of exotic fish, the Coral Sea is a unique haven of biodiversity off the northeastern coast of Australia.
exotic.translationZh: 珊瑚海位于澳大利亚东北海岸附近，拥有原始珊瑚礁、珍稀鲨鱼和大量奇异鱼类，是一个独特的生物多样性天堂。
exotic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

exotic.sentenceEn: However, many schools seem to ignore the advice; and it does not cover the kind of glamorous, exotic trips, which are becoming increasingly common.
exotic.translationZh: 然而，许多学校似乎无视这一建议；而且该建议也未涵盖那些越来越普遍的奢华异国旅行。
exotic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

exotic.sentenceEn: What does Dr. Michael Rosenzweig think of exotic and native species?
exotic.translationZh: 迈克尔·罗森茨威格博士如何看待外来物种和本地物种？

exotic.sentenceEn: It is not deemed exotic by Proper Bostonians.
exotic.translationZh: 在正宗波士顿人眼中，这并不算是什么新奇事物。

economics.sentenceEn: Though a layman of economics , at least I know that investing with borrowed money will turn the borrower into the predator rather than the decent and kind lender.
economics.translationZh: 虽然我对经济学一窍不通，但至少知道借钱投资会让借款人变成掠夺者，而非原本正派善良的贷款人。
economics.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

economics.sentenceEn: Attracted by the improved economics of urban areas, country-dwellers across the world are moving out, contributing to the excessive crowdedness of densely populated cities, and leaving the countryside in desolation.
economics.translationZh: 受城市地区经济改善的吸引，世界各地的农村居民纷纷迁出，导致人口稠密城市过度拥挤，而乡村则日益荒芜。
economics.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

economics.sentenceEn: Most universities will encourage you to learn different things from fields as wide-ranging as philosophy and economics .
economics.translationZh: 大多数大学会鼓励你学习各种不同领域的知识，范围广泛，涵盖哲学和经济学等学科。
economics.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第2句

economics.sentenceEn: The economics of a tiny college, in other words, might be similar to that of a tiny house.
economics.translationZh: 换句话说，小型学院的经济模式或许与微型住宅相似。

economics.sentenceEn: Courses like science, technology, engineering, and math, and economics , where the average graduate earns a lot, should be favored.
economics.translationZh: 而科学、技术、工程、数学及经济学等专业的毕业生平均收入较高，应当受到青睐。
economics.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

economics.sentenceEn: It is the first to compare organic and conventional agriculture across the main goals of sustainability identified by the National Academy of Sciences: productivity, economics , and environment.
economics.translationZh: 这是首项基于美国国家科学院确定的可持续发展主要目标（生产力、经济效益和环境影响）对有机农业和传统农业进行全面比较的研究。
economics.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

exaggerate.sentenceEn: Abundant research shows the harms of social isolation, considered a serious public health problem in countries that have rapidly ageing populations (though talk of a 'loneliness epidemic' may be exaggerated ).
exaggerate.translationZh: 大量研究表明，社会隔离会带来诸多危害。在人口快速老龄化的国家，这已被视为一个严重的公共卫生问题（尽管有关“孤独流行病”的说法可能言过其实）。

exaggerate.sentenceEn: It's possible that Steel is exaggerating the demands of her schedule.
exaggerate.translationZh: 斯蒂尔有可能在夸大其日程安排的强度。
exaggerate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

exaggerate.sentenceEn: When college students were reminded of a time they had been excluded in a social setting they compensated by exaggerating their number of friends—unless they were first given tasks that caused them to interact with their phone as if it had human qualities.
exaggerate.translationZh: 当大学生被唤起某次在社交场合遭到排斥的记忆时，他们会通过夸大自己的朋友数量来进行心理补偿——除非事先被安排了一些任务，让他们以仿佛手机具备人性特质的方式与手机互动。
exaggerate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

exaggerate.sentenceEn: The impact of a basic discovery on human health can be exaggerated so that the public thinks a miraculous cure is a few months to years away when in reality the significance of the study is far more limited.
exaggerate.translationZh: 一项基础发现对人类健康的影响可能被夸大，以至于公众认为神奇的治愈方法只需几个月到几年就能实现，而实际上这项研究的意义要有限得多。
exaggerate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

exaggerate.sentenceEn: Even during the turbulent years of last century, youth rebellion was often exaggerated in the media.
exaggerate.translationZh: 即使在上世纪动荡的年代，媒体对青年叛逆的报道也常常言过其实。

exaggerate.sentenceEn: Exaggerate their sense of shame and worthlessness.
exaggerate.translationZh: 夸大他们的羞耻感和无价值感

emphasis.sentenceEn: Solidarity is also viewed as a reaction to the extreme emphasis on individualism and freedom of choice.
emphasis.translationZh: 团结也被视为是对极度强调个人主义和选择自由的一种回应。
emphasis.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

emphasis.sentenceEn: We are beginning to see what a tremendous price we've paid for our emphasis on independence and autonomy.
emphasis.translationZh: 我们开始意识到，为了强调独立与自主，我们付出了多么巨大的代价。
emphasis.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

emphasis.sentenceEn: Perhaps this is why they placed such strong emphasis on responsiveness in a crisis—"someone I can call on for help."
emphasis.translationZh: 或许这就是为什么他们如此强调在危机时刻的响应能力——即“一个我可以求助的人”。
emphasis.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

emphasis.sentenceEn: This is surprising when you consider the prevailing emphasis by scholars and trainers and managers on the importance of cultivating close interpersonal relationships at work.
emphasis.translationZh: 然而，考虑到学者、培训师和管理者们普遍强调在职场中培养密切人际关系的重要性，我的这种感受着实令人惊讶。
emphasis.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

emphasis.sentenceEn: According to Chinese officials, their activities in Antarctica lay greater emphasis on scientific research.
emphasis.translationZh: 中国官员表示，他们在南极洲的活动更侧重于科学研究。

emphasis.sentenceEn: Too much emphasis had been placed on one's occupation.
emphasis.translationZh: 人们过度强调了一个人的职业

engineering.sentenceEn: "Restaurants will prepare food ahead of orders coming in," predicts Just Eat's director of engineering , Daniel Richardson.
engineering.translationZh: Just Eat 的工程总监丹尼尔·理查森预测：“餐厅将在订单到来之前就开始准备食物。”

engineering.sentenceEn: But in my case, I got a degree in electrical engineering followed by six years' service in the air force.
engineering.translationZh: 至于我，我先是获得了电气工程学位，随后又在空军服役了六年。
engineering.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第3句

engineering.sentenceEn: My argument is that we need to use more of our budget on areas like science and engineering .
engineering.translationZh: 我的论点是，我们需要将更多预算投入科学和工程等领域。
engineering.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第2句

engineering.sentenceEn: In particular, I'm attracted to the marriage of design and engineering .
engineering.translationZh: 尤其是，我被设计与工程的结合深深吸引。
engineering.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

engineering.sentenceEn: Courses like science, technology, engineering , and math, and economics, where the average graduate earns a lot, should be favored.
engineering.translationZh: 而科学、技术、工程、数学及经济学等专业的毕业生平均收入较高，应当受到青睐。
engineering.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

engineering.sentenceEn: Literature should get as much funding as engineering .
engineering.translationZh: 文学应该获得与工程学同等的资金支持。

expansion.sentenceEn: The maps tracing America's westward expansion are telling.
expansion.translationZh: 这些描绘美国西进扩张的地图很能说明问题。
expansion.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

expansion.sentenceEn: Proposition 58, passed by California voters on November 8, largely reversed that decision, paving the way for a huge expansion of bilingual education in the state that has the largest population of English-language learners.
expansion.translationZh: 11月8日，加州选民通过了58号提案，在很大程度上推翻了这一决定，为该州大规模扩大双语教育铺平了道路——加州拥有全美最多的英语学习者。

expansion.sentenceEn: Opponents worry that such expansion would be costly for taxpayers, but advocates say it would save money in the long run.
expansion.translationZh: 反对者担心这种扩展会增加纳税人的负担，但支持者表示从长远来看这将节省资金。

expansion.sentenceEn: Some critics also question whether the quality of care is keeping up with the rapid expansion of telemedicine.
expansion.translationZh: 一些批评者还质疑医疗质量是否能跟上远程医疗的快速扩张步伐。

expansion.sentenceEn: People raced to address increasing traffic problems along with the expansion of cities and traffic.
expansion.translationZh: 随着城市规模的扩大和交通量的增长，人们正争分夺秒地解决日益严重的交通问题。

expansion.sentenceEn: It contributes to rapid business expansion .
expansion.translationZh: 它有助于业务的快速扩张。

external.sentenceEn: External sources of information can help you see angles and possibilities you might not have considered.
external.translationZh: 外部信息源可以帮助你发现那些你可能尚未考虑到的角度和可能性。

external.sentenceEn: It's also helpful to seek external sources of information, rather than relying solely on your thinking and instincts.
external.translationZh: 寻求外部信息来源也很有帮助，而不是仅仅依赖你自己的思考和直觉。

external.sentenceEn: They also rated the extent to which they believed success in life is related to various internal factors (such as ambition) and external factors (such as family wealth).

external.sentenceEn: This might be the case because rich individuals have more access to other sources of happiness—many of which will be external , like lack of stress or community.

external.sentenceEn: Before children have even developed a proper sense of their own identity, or learned to handle money, they're encouraged to associate status and self-worth with stuff, and to look to external things such as fame and wealth for validation.

external.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

emergency.sentenceEn: If an emergency vehicle came, the officer could flip a switch and clear the intersection by triggering all red lights.
emergency.translationZh: 如果救急车辆驶来，警员可以拨动开关，通过触发全红灯信号来清空十字路口。

emergency.sentenceEn: The emergency vehicle could now pass effortlessly.
emergency.translationZh: 急救车辆现在可以毫不费力地通过了。

emergency.sentenceEn: But as the emergency services picked through the burnt debris, a row was resurfacing over accusations that the beloved cathedral, immortalised in Victor Hugo's novel, was already crumbling before the fire.
emergency.translationZh: 然而，就在应急人员在烧焦的废墟中搜寻之际，一场争论再次浮现——有人指责这座因维克多·雨果的小说而不朽的圣母院，在火灾发生前就已经摇摇欲坠了。

emergency.sentenceEn: They can rely on their accumulated wisdom in an emergency .
emergency.translationZh: 在紧急情况下，他们可以依靠自己积累的智慧。

enormous.sentenceEn: "Telemedicine holds enormous promise, but these sites are just not ready for prime time," says Jack Resneck, the study's lead author.

equally.sentenceEn: The Ambury Hills above the village remain untouched by human development, and the Sonora Valley just below it is equally stunning.
equally.translationZh: 村庄上方的安伯里山群仍未受到人类开发的影响，而山脚下的索诺拉山谷同样令人惊叹。
equally.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

equally.sentenceEn: Equally important, tiny colleges ask, "How can education contribute to human flourishing and the well-being of the world?"
equally.translationZh: 同样重要的是，小型学院会问：“教育如何能促进人的全面发展和世界的福祉？”

equally.sentenceEn: Where once salvors and archaeologists worked side by side, now they belong to opposing, and equally contemptuous, tribes.
equally.translationZh: 曾经打捞人员与考古学家并肩合作，如今却成了相互对立、彼此鄙夷的阵营。

equally.sentenceEn: It is equally imperative to emphasize that being an expert on a topic does not automatically make a scholar qualified to communicate it to a nonscientific audience.
equally.translationZh: 同样必须强调的是，成为某一领域的专家并不自动意味着这位学者就有资格向非科学受众传播该领域知识。
equally.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

equally.sentenceEn: It is wrong to assume the strategies we use to start a change of behavior will work equally well in helping maintain it.
equally.translationZh: 认为我们用来启动行为改变的策略同样能有效帮助维持这种改变，这种想法是错误的。

essentially.sentenceEn: "Since our bodies are essentially made anew every few weeks, the material in them alone is clearly insufficient to explain the persistent thread of an identity."
essentially.translationZh: 既然我们的身体每隔几周就基本上会更新一次，那么显然仅凭体内的物质不足以解释身份认同这一持续存在的脉络。
essentially.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

essentially.sentenceEn: W: Essentially , we would like the new deal to exclude the Middle East.
essentially.translationZh: 女：本质上，我们希望新协议不包括中东地区。

essentially.sentenceEn: This legislative proposal essentially set out to harmonize the aesthetic appearance of all the houses in Berkton.
essentially.translationZh: 这项立法提案的本质目的是统一伯克顿所有房屋的外观美感。
essentially.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第5句

essentially.sentenceEn: When an employee sits through an ineffective meeting their brain power is essentially being drained away.
essentially.translationZh: 当员工参加一场低效会议时，他们的脑力实质上在被慢慢消耗。

essentially.sentenceEn: Essentially , they don't yield to pressure to buy the latest thing or to keep up with others or what they have acquired.
essentially.translationZh: 本质上，他们不会屈服于购买最新潮物品的压力，也不会去攀比他人或他人所拥有的东西。
essentially.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

essentially.sentenceEn: They essentially learn to become more sympathetic to themselves.
essentially.translationZh: 他们从根本上学会了对自己更加同情。

exhibit.sentenceEn: So why don't more employees intervene when they see someone exhibiting at-risk behavior in the workplace?
exhibit.translationZh: 那么，为什么当员工看到有人在工作场所表现出危险行为时，很少有人出面干预呢？
exhibit.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

exhibit.sentenceEn: Nature exhibits some of the universal aesthetic features, such as radiance, in a common way throughout the world.
exhibit.translationZh: 自然界以一种普遍的方式在全球范围内展现出一些共通的审美特征，例如光彩。
exhibit.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第1句

exhibit.sentenceEn: In both groups, the researchers found the closer a town's average annual temperature was to 22 degrees, the more its population exhibited those personality characteristics.
exhibit.translationZh: 在两组人群中，研究人员发现，一个城镇的年平均气温越接近22度，该城镇的居民就越明显地表现出这些性格特征。
exhibit.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第7句

exhibit.sentenceEn: Individuals who regularly engage in gratitude exercises, such as counting their blessings or expressing gratitude to others, exhibit increased satisfaction with relationships and fewer symptoms of physical illness.
exhibit.translationZh: 经常进行感恩练习的人，比如细数自己的福气或向他人表达感谢，对人际关系的满意度会更高，身体疾病的症状也会更少。

exhibit.sentenceEn: What would we expect an editorial board of an academic journal to exhibit in view of its important responsibilities?
exhibit.translationZh: 鉴于学术期刊编辑委员会肩负的重要职责，我们期望它展现出什么样的特质呢？

exhibit.sentenceEn: They come out with better photographs of the exhibits .
exhibit.translationZh: 他们拍出的展品照片效果更好。

endeavor.sentenceEn: Alternately, you could also seek out hard data that illuminates your real chance of success in whatever endeavor you are contemplating.
endeavor.translationZh: 或者，你也可以寻找确凿的数据，以此来说明你在目前考虑的任何尝试中获得成功的真实几率。

endeavor.sentenceEn: We are all susceptible to the sunk-cost delusion, an unconscious bias that leads us to persist in an endeavor we have already invested time, effort, or money into — even when abandoning it would be more beneficial.
endeavor.translationZh: 我们都容易受到沉没成本谬误的影响。这是一种无意识的偏见，促使我们坚持投入了时间、精力或金钱的事业——即便放弃它会更有利。

endeavor.sentenceEn: Sometime in the 19th century a Georgian called Colonel William Jackson reportedly took a liking to the said tree and endeavored to protect it from any danger.
endeavor.translationZh: 据报道，在19世纪的某个时候，一位名叫威廉·杰克逊上校的格鲁吉亚人喜欢上了这棵树，并尽力保护它免受任何危险。

endeavor.sentenceEn: They also recommend that people simultaneously endeavor to restrict consumption of sweets, sugar and red meat.
endeavor.translationZh: 他们还建议人们同时努力限制甜食、糖和红肉的摄入。
endeavor.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

endeavor.sentenceEn: When people are thinking of an endeavor , they should dig out reliable data that tells them how likely they are to succeed.
endeavor.translationZh: 当人们考虑从事某项事业时，应当挖掘可靠的数据，以了解成功的可能性。

endeavor.sentenceEn: People's happiness is built upon their own endeavor .
endeavor.translationZh: 人们的幸福建立在自身努力的基础之上。

entertainment.sentenceEn: Kim concludes that "rags-to-riches entertainment media are an important cultural force that promotes and perpetuates beliefs in upward mobility".

entertainment.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第1句

entertainment.sentenceEn: "In this era of choice, entertainment media is what captures hearts and minds," Kim writes.
entertainment.translationZh: 金写道：“在这个选择的时代，娱乐媒体最能俘获人心。”
entertainment.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第1句

entertainment.sentenceEn: I am fascinated with the paradox of horror—the strange fact that many people seek out scary entertainment .
entertainment.translationZh: 我对恐怖的悖论很着迷——许多人热衷于恐怖娱乐这一奇怪现象。
entertainment.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

entertainment.sentenceEn: As Neil Postman noted in his 1985 book Amusing Ourselves to Death, the rise of television introduced not just a new medium but a new discourse: a gradual shift from a typographic(印刷的) culture to a photographic one, which in turn meant a shift from rationality to emotions, exposition to entertainment .
entertainment.translationZh: 正如尼尔·波兹曼在其1985年著作《娱乐至死》中所指出的，电视的兴起不仅带来了一种新媒介，更带来了一种新的话语方式：从印刷文化向影像文化的逐步转变，而这反过来又意味着从理性向情感、从阐述向娱乐的转变。
entertainment.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

entertainment.sentenceEn: Why do many people seek out scary entertainment , according to the author's research?
entertainment.translationZh: 根据作者的研究，为什么许多人会寻求恐怖类娱乐？

entertainment.sentenceEn: It marked a new age in the entertainment industry.
entertainment.translationZh: 它标志着娱乐产业进入了一个新时代。

existing.sentenceEn: While there are some existing technologies to purify indoor air, they can be inefficient, expensive or produce harmful by-products.

existing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

existing.sentenceEn: While the mechanisms behind these associations are not fully understood, Monteiro argues that the existing evidence is sufficient to justify discouraging consumption of ultra-processed foods in dietary recommendations and government policies.

evolution.sentenceEn: In their evolution , humans have learned to pay attention to the most urgent issues instead of long-term concerns.

evolutionary.sentenceEn: In our evolutionary past, it was a very good thing that our attention could be easily seized by negative information, since it might well indicate a dangerous risk to our own survival.

Such inclinations are essential to our survival. For most of our evolutionary history, our ancestors lived in tribes. Becoming separated from the tribe—or worse, being cast out—was a death sentence."

evolutionary.sentenceEn: What we see today is the product of evolutionary events resulting from the dispersal of a few human populations out of Africa around 60,000 to 70,000 years ago.
