equity.sentenceEn: The process towards salary equity at work began to reverse.
equity.translationZh: 职场薪酬公平的进程开始出现逆转。

exact.sentenceEn: No one is putting an exact date on it yet.
exact.translationZh: 目前还没有人给出确切日期。

exact.sentenceEn: At any age, we might experience difficulty finding the exact word we want or have trouble remembering the name of the person we just met.
exact.translationZh: 在任何年龄段，我们都可能难以找到恰当的词语表达，或者记不起刚刚认识的人的名字。

exact.sentenceEn: M: Obviously, I can't disclose the exact amount he paid, but it was substantial.
exact.translationZh: 男：显然，我不能透露他支付的具体金额，但数额相当可观。
exact.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第10段，第1句

exact.sentenceEn: The American dollar bill is colored with black ink on one side and green on the other; the exact composition of the paper and ink is a closely guarded government secret.
exact.translationZh: 美国 dollar 纸币一面印有黑色油墨，另一面为绿色；纸张和油墨的确切成分是政府严格保守的秘密。
exact.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

exact.sentenceEn: The scientists asked this exact question as part of the study we're discussing today.
exact.translationZh: 科学家们在我们今天讨论的这项研究中，就提出了这个确切的问题。
exact.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

exact.sentenceEn: What does the speaker say about the exact composition of the American dollar bill?
exact.translationZh: 关于美国纸币的确切成分，讲述者说了什么？

excessive.sentenceEn: It is possible that their emotions were only validated in childhood when they were at their loudest, encouraging them to adopt responses to discomfort that are excessive in most situations.
excessive.translationZh: 这可能是因为他们在童年时期，只有在闹得最凶时情绪才会得到认可，这促使他们养成了一种在大多数情况下都表现得过于激进的不适反应方式。
excessive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

excessive.sentenceEn: Attracted by the improved economics of urban areas, country-dwellers across the world are moving out, contributing to the excessive crowdedness of densely populated cities, and leaving the countryside in desolation.
excessive.translationZh: 受城市地区经济改善的吸引，世界各地的农村居民纷纷迁出，导致人口稠密城市过度拥挤，而乡村则日益荒芜。
excessive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

excessive.sentenceEn: Excessive media exposure, including television, can displace exploratory activities such as play and parent-child interactions, which are believed to be key to cultivating curiosity in kids.
excessive.translationZh: 过度的媒体曝光，包括看电视，会挤占探索性活动的时间，如玩耍和亲子互动，而这些活动被认为是培养孩子好奇心的关键。
excessive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

excessive.sentenceEn: Now, too many developers are experiencing excessive delays.
excessive.translationZh: 而如今，太多开发商正遭遇无休止的审批延误。

excessive.sentenceEn: Zachary Silver, an American researcher, believes the authors of the new study overstated the idea that an excessive amount of research has been devoted to dogs, as the field of dog cognition is young, and there is much to be learned about how dogs think.
excessive.translationZh: 美国研究员扎卡里·西尔弗认为，这项新研究的作者夸大了“过多研究都投入到狗身上”这一观点，因为狗认知研究领域尚处于起步阶段，关于狗的思维方式还有很多有待探索。
excessive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

excessive.sentenceEn: What does the passage say about excessive media exposure?
excessive.translationZh: 这篇文章对过度媒体曝光有何论述？

educate.sentenceEn: When shrinking municipal budgets combine with the nonstop technological revolution, public library services that focus on building communities face-to-face, inspiring and educating patrons about art, literature, and music, and helping patrons engage in civil discourse can seem old-fashioned.
educate.translationZh: 当不断缩减的市政预算遇上永不停歇的技术革命，那些专注于面对面社区建设、启发和教育读者了解艺术、文学和音乐，以及帮助读者参与公民对话的公共图书馆服务，似乎显得有些过时了。

educate.sentenceEn: Beyond competent workers and supervisors, it's important to educate everyone within the organization that they are obliged to intervene if they witness a possible unsafe act, whether you're a designated competent person, a supervisor or a frontline worker.
educate.translationZh: 除了合格的员工和主管外，重要的是要让组织内的每个人都明白：无论你是指定的合格人员、主管还是一线员工，只要目睹可能不安全的行为，都有义务进行干预。
educate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第1句

educate.sentenceEn: Located on a working cattle ranch on the California-Nevada border, Deep Springs is a private, residential, two-year college for men, committed to educating students for "a life of service to humanity."
educate.translationZh: 深泉学院坐落于加利福尼亚州与内华达州边境的一个经营性牧场上，是一所私立寄宿制男子两年制学院，致力于培养学生为“服务人类的一生”做好准备。

educate.sentenceEn: To motivate visitors to bring in more old shoes, Adidas Brazil promotes the program in stores by showing videos to educate customers, and it even offers a discount each time a customer brings in an old pair of shoes.
educate.translationZh: 为了鼓励顾客提交更多旧鞋，阿迪达斯巴西分公司在门店内通过播放视频向顾客进行宣传教育，甚至还为每次提交旧鞋的顾客提供折扣优惠。

educate.sentenceEn: Tiny colleges focus on educating students to become well-rounded citizens instead of seeking their own expansion.
educate.translationZh: 小型学院专注于将学生培养成全面发展的公民，而非追求自身扩张。

educate.sentenceEn: Blue-collar workers will have to bear the cost of educating would-be high-earners.
educate.translationZh: 蓝领工人将不得不承担培养未来高收入者的教育成本。

efficiently.sentenceEn: Food crops could be engineered to produce tardigrade proteins, allowing these organisms to grow more efficiently on spacecraft where levels of radiation are elevated compared with on Earth.
efficiently.translationZh: 粮食作物可以通过基因工程改造来产生水熊虫蛋白质，使这些生物体能够在辐射水平高于地球的航天器上更高效地生长。
efficiently.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

efficiently.sentenceEn: His elastic, 6-foot frame bounced gently and efficiently off the ground with each step of the hilly six-mile trip back to Arlington.
efficiently.translationZh: 他那六英尺高、富有弹性的身躯，在返回阿灵顿的六英里丘陵路段上，每一步都轻盈而高效地跃离地面。

efficiently.sentenceEn: Marconi's career was devoted to making wireless communication happen cheaply, efficiently , smoothly, and with an elegance that would appear to be intuitive and uncomplicated to the user-friendly, if you will.
efficiently.translationZh: 马可尼的职业生涯致力于让无线通信变得成本低廉、高效流畅，并且其设计优雅直观，易于用户操作，如果你愿意这么说的话。

efficiently.sentenceEn: People can shop more efficiently online and therefore don't need to go to as many stores to find what they want.
efficiently.translationZh: 人们可以更高效地进行网上购物，因此无需光顾那么多实体店就能找到自己想要的商品。

efficiently.sentenceEn: Sometimes the old stuff just works better or more efficiently .
efficiently.translationZh: 有时旧物件反而更好用或更高效。
efficiently.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

efficiently.sentenceEn: It shows that "night owls" work much less efficiently .
efficiently.translationZh: 这表明“夜猫子”的工作效率要低得多。

emotionally.sentenceEn: Also, other people in their life benefit even more because they no longer have to hear the emotionally hurtful language of sarcasm.
emotionally.translationZh: 此外，他们生活中的其他人获益更多，因为他们再也不必听到讽刺这种伤害感情的语言了。
emotionally.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

emotionally.sentenceEn: Left-brained people are supposedly logical and excel at language and math while right-brained people are more imaginative, emotionally intelligent and skilled with spatial reasoning.
emotionally.translationZh: 据说左脑型的人逻辑性强，擅长语言和数学，而右脑型的人则更富有想象力，情商更高，并且在空间推理方面更有天赋。
emotionally.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

emotionally.sentenceEn: A city with an average annual temperature closer to 22 tends to have a population who are more agreeable, conscientious, emotionally stable, and outgoing.
emotionally.translationZh: 年均气温接近22摄氏度的城市，其居民往往更随和、更有责任心、情绪更稳定且更外向。
emotionally.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

emotionally.sentenceEn: Once people are emotionally engaged, they'll stick with you.
emotionally.translationZh: 一旦人们在情感上产生共鸣，他们就会一直支持你。
emotionally.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第7句

emotionally.sentenceEn: In other words, when highly anxious individuals took in otherwise emotionally neutral information that was presented to them, it became colored by their negative mindset, making them remember the information better.
emotionally.translationZh: 换句话说，当高度焦虑的人接收那些原本情绪中立的信息时，这些信息会被他们的负面心态所“染色”，从而使他们能更好地记住这些信息。
emotionally.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

emotionally.translationZh: 他们的情感可能比较脆弱。

equip.sentenceEn: They gather "data exhaust" left by employees' email and instant messaging apps, and use name badges equipped with radio-frequency identification devices and microphones.
equip.translationZh: 他们收集员工通过电子邮件和即时通讯应用产生的“数据废气”，并使用配备了射频识别装置和麦克风的姓名徽章。
equip.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

equip.sentenceEn: Equipped with this knowledge, consumers can make better choices about which products to buy.
equip.translationZh: 有了这些信息，消费者就能在购买产品时做出更明智的选择。
equip.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

equip.sentenceEn: These days, they're equipped with all the modern comforts.
equip.translationZh: 如今的房车都配备了各种现代化的舒适设施。
equip.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

equip.sentenceEn: We are not psychologically well equipped to judge our own thinking.
equip.translationZh: 我们在心理上并不具备评判自身思维的能力。
equip.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

equip.sentenceEn: What can robots do when equipped with high-tech sensors and complex learning algorithms?
equip.translationZh: 配备高科技传感器和复杂学习算法的机器人能做什么？

equip.sentenceEn: They are equipped with raw strength for solving the most challenging problems.
equip.translationZh: 它们具备解决最具挑战性问题的原始力量。

equipment.sentenceEn: However, that does not mean one needs professional equipment .
equipment.translationZh: 然而，这并不意味着需要专业设备。
equipment.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第4句

equipment.sentenceEn: Part of their job is to intervene when workers perform a task without the proper equipment or if the conditions are unsafe.
equipment.translationZh: 他们的部分工作是在工人未使用适当设备执行任务或工作条件不安全时进行干预。
equipment.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

equipment.sentenceEn: It could charge a profitable markup by offering just a bit more technical equipment and professional service than competitors.
equipment.translationZh: 通过仅提供比竞争对手稍多一些的技术设备和专业服务，它就能收取可观的加价。
equipment.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第15段，第4句

equipment.sentenceEn: In recent years, advances in radar, diving, detection equipment , computers, and GPS have transformed the hunt.
equipment.translationZh: 近年来，雷达、潜水技术、探测设备、计算机及全球定位系统（GPS）的进步，彻底改变了这场寻宝行动。

equipment.sentenceEn: American scientists complain about lack of sufficient money and equipment for their expansion in Antarctica.
equipment.translationZh: 美国研究人员悄悄抱怨预算限制，并且拥有的破冰船数量远少于俄罗斯，这限制了美国在南极洲的活动范围。

equipment.sentenceEn: It may lead to athletes' over-reliance on equipment .
equipment.translationZh: 这可能会导致运动员过度依赖装备。

ethical.sentenceEn: However, it is unclear whether these new products can be considered ethical .
ethical.translationZh: 然而，这些新产品是否能被视为合乎道德的产品，目前尚不清楚。
ethical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

ethical.sentenceEn: In the past, ethical products, whether they were fair trade or organic, came at a premium.
ethical.translationZh: 过去，道德产品无论是公平贸易产品还是有机产品，价格都相对较高。
ethical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

ethical.sentenceEn: This means, when confronted by an entitled team member, an ethical leader is significantly disinclined to accommodate their demands.
ethical.translationZh: 这意味着，当遇到有这种特权感的团队成员时，有道德的领导者会明显倾向于不满足他们的要求。
ethical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

ethical.sentenceEn: But there's no denying ethical leadership is at least a critical step in the right direction.
ethical.translationZh: 但不可否认的是，道德领导力至少是朝着正确方向迈出的关键一步。
ethical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

ethical.sentenceEn: The findings revealed ethical leadership is precisely what alleviates the negative effects of employee entitlement.
ethical.translationZh: 研究结果显示，道德型领导正是缓解员工特权感负面影响的关键因素。
ethical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第6句

ethical.sentenceEn: What do the research findings reveal about ethical leaders?
ethical.translationZh: 研究结果揭示了道德型领导者的哪些特质？

experimental.sentenceEn: And yet a new paper in the Quarterly Journal of Experimental Psychology suggests that we actually have very poor awareness of our own belief change, meaning that we will tend to underestimate how much we've been swayed by a convincing article.
experimental.translationZh: 然而，《实验心理学季刊》上的一项新研究表明，我们实际上对自己的信念变化缺乏清晰的认知，这意味着我们往往会低估自己被一篇有说服力的文章所影响的程度。
experimental.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

experimental.sentenceEn: By studying imprinting, the authors of this study have shown for the first time that an animal can learn relationships between concepts without training, said Jeffrey Katz, an experimental psychologist at Auburn University who was not involved in the study.
experimental.translationZh: 奥本大学实验心理学家杰弗里·卡茨并未参与这项研究，他表示：“通过对印记行为的研究，该研究的作者首次证明动物无需训练就能学习概念之间的关系。”
experimental.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第1句

experimental.sentenceEn: The study, published Thursday in Science, challenges our idea of what it means to have a birdbrain, said Edward Wasserman, an experimental psychologist at the University of Iowa who wrote an independent review of the study.
experimental.translationZh: 艾奥瓦大学实验心理学家爱德华·沃瑟曼为该研究撰写了独立评论，他表示：“这项于周四发表在《科学》杂志上的研究，挑战了我们对‘鸟脑’（意指愚蠢）的理解。”
experimental.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

experimental.sentenceEn: It can screen hundreds of millions of compounds to identify a few interesting candidates that require experimental testing.
experimental.translationZh: 它能够筛选数亿种化合物，以识别出少数需要实验测试的潜在候选化合物。
experimental.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第14句

experimental.sentenceEn: What does a new paper in the *Quarterly Journal of Experimental Psychology* suggest?
experimental.translationZh: 《实验心理学季刊》上的一篇新论文提出了什么观点？

experimental.sentenceEn: It was conducted by experimental psychologists.
experimental.translationZh: 该研究由实验心理学家开展。

exploit.sentenceEn: My research suggests that horror works by exploiting an ancient set of biological defence mechanisms—an evolved fear system, which we share with other animals.
exploit.translationZh: 我的研究表明，恐怖作品通过利用一套古老的生物防御机制——一种我们与其他动物共有的进化恐惧系统——来产生效果。
exploit.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第12段，第2句

exploit.sentenceEn: Our research suggests that global winners typically create and sustain their international presence through a systematic process of exploiting , renewing and enhancing their core capabilities.
exploit.translationZh: 我们的研究表明，全球赢家通常通过系统性地利用、更新和增强其核心能力来建立并维持其国际影响力。
exploit.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

exploit.sentenceEn: Apple has been able to leverage and exploit its California-based design and marketing advantages successfully throughout the world.
exploit.translationZh: 苹果公司成功地将其总部位于加利福尼亚的设计和营销优势推广并应用到了全球各地。
exploit.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

exploit.sentenceEn: In engineering and exploiting and transforming our habitat, we have opened tens of thousands of Pandora's boxes.
exploit.translationZh: 在改造、开发和改变我们的栖息地过程中，我们已经打开了无数个潘多拉魔盒。

exploit.sentenceEn: It is difficult to find solid evidence to prove environmental friendliness generates more profits than exploiting the natural environment.
exploit.translationZh: 很难找到确凿证据证明环保比开发自然环境能产生更多利润。

exploit.sentenceEn: They exploit these workers' passion to benefit themselves.
exploit.translationZh: 他们利用这些员工的热情为自己谋利。

eager.sentenceEn: Add to that more middle-income consumers searching for nutritious foods and others eager to try the unprocessed foods their grandparents once ate, she says.
eager.translationZh: 她表示，此外还有更多中等收入消费者在寻找营养食品，以及另一些人渴望尝试他们祖父母曾经吃过的未经加工的食物。

eager.sentenceEn: While employers and health plans have been eager to cover virtual urgent-care visits, insurers have been far less willing to pay for telemedicine when doctors use phone, email or video to consult with existing patients about continuing issues.
eager.translationZh: 虽然雇主和医疗计划一直热衷于为虚拟紧急护理就诊提供保险，但当医生使用电话、电子邮件或视频与现有患者就持续性问题进行咨询时，保险公司却远不愿意为这种远程医疗服务付费。

eager.sentenceEn: Since there were few museums anywhere in Europe before the close of the eighteenth century, Grand Tourists often saw paintings and sculptures by gaining admission to private collections, and many were eager to acquire examples of Greco-Roman and Italian art for their own collections.
eager.translationZh: 由于18世纪末以前欧洲各地博物馆寥寥无几，大游学旅行者们常常通过获准进入私人收藏来观赏绘画和雕塑，而且许多人渴望为自己的收藏获取希腊罗马和意大利艺术品。
eager.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第6句

eager.sentenceEn: A few years later, a large defense buildup finally provided a fiscal stimulus adequate to the economy's needs—and suddenly industry was eager to employ those "unadaptable and untrained" workers.
eager.translationZh: 几年后，大规模的国防建设最终提供了足以满足经济需求的财政刺激——突然间，企业迫切希望雇佣这些"无法适应且缺乏培训"的工人了。
eager.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

eager.sentenceEn: More automation appears to be a certainty in industries eager to cut labor costs and raise profits.
eager.translationZh: 对于那些渴望降低劳动力成本并提高利润的行业来说，进一步实现自动化似乎已成必然。

eager.sentenceEn: His meeting with Gonzalez had made him eager to learn more about the tribe.
eager.translationZh: 与冈萨雷斯的会面让他渴望更多地了解这个部落。

economically.sentenceEn: One positive consequence of this age shift is that a larger proportion of new mothers are economically prepared to raise children.
economically.translationZh: 这种年龄变化的一个积极影响是，更大比例的新妈妈在经济上已做好抚养孩子的准备。
economically.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

economically.sentenceEn: One government proposition is to eliminate $10,000 of debt for 'economically distressed' students.
economically.translationZh: 政府的一项提议是为“经济困难”学生免除1万美元债务。
economically.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

economically.sentenceEn: Some in US Congress have gone so far as to suggest forgiving up to $50,000 in debt per student borrower, but does forgiving student debt necessarily correlate to helping the economically disadvantaged?
economically.translationZh: 美国国会中甚至有人提议，每位学生借款人可获得高达5万美元的债务减免，但减免学生债务就一定意味着能帮助经济困难群体吗？
economically.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

economically.sentenceEn: Occupation and social economic status were the most strongly correlated, suggesting that our values are more economically driven than we usually give them credit for.
economically.translationZh: 职业和社会经济地位的相关性最强，这表明我们的价值观受经济因素的驱动程度超出了我们通常的认知。
economically.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

economically.sentenceEn: Ethnically and economically balanced bilingual classrooms are found to be helpful for kids to get used to social and cultural diversity.
economically.translationZh: 研究发现，族裔和经济背景均衡的双语课堂有助于孩子们适应社会和文化多样性。

economically.sentenceEn: More new mothers are economically able to raise children.
economically.translationZh: 越来越多的新妈妈具备抚养孩子的经济能力。

endless.sentenceEn: There are surely endless examples of innovative library services for children, including the Middle Country Public Library's Nature Explorium, which engages children in learning about the natural world.

extract.translationZh: 企业在创建循环经济方面发挥着重要作用。在循环经济中，价值的创造更多来自于更好地利用现有资源，而非开采新资源——但企业也必须让消费者参与到这一过程中。

extract.sentenceEn: But it's said to no longer contain kola nut extract , relying instead on artificial imitations to achieve the flavour.
extract.translationZh: 但据说其配方中已不再含有可乐果提取物，而是依靠人工仿制品来实现这种风味。
extract.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

extract.sentenceEn: One such popular medicinal drink was Vin Mariani, a French product consisting of coca extract mixed with red wine.
extract.translationZh: 当时有一种广受欢迎的药用饮品叫做马里亚尼葡萄酒（Vin Mariani），这是一种法国产品，由古柯叶提取物与红葡萄酒混合而成。
extract.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

extract.sentenceEn: It still relies on traditional kola nut extract .
extract.translationZh: 它仍然依赖传统的可乐果提取物。

enjoyable.sentenceEn: This excitement makes pursuing goals enjoyable and stimulates pleasure and pride that would result from success.
enjoyable.translationZh: 这种兴奋感让追求目标的过程变得令人愉悦，并激发了成功后将会产生的愉悦感和自豪感。
enjoyable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

enjoyable.sentenceEn: It can hinder other more positive motivation types, such as completing a task purely because it's fulfilling or enjoyable .
enjoyable.translationZh: 它会阻碍其他更积极的动机类型，比如纯粹因为某项任务能带来成就感或乐趣而去完成它。
enjoyable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

enjoyable.sentenceEn: In an experiment, commuters who talked to nearby strangers found their commute more enjoyable than those who didn't.
enjoyable.translationZh: 在一项实验中，与身边陌生人交流的通勤者发现他们的通勤体验比不交流的人更愉快。
enjoyable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

enjoyable.sentenceEn: To the relief of Instagrammers(Instagram用户) everywhere, it can even make meals more enjoyable .
enjoyable.translationZh: 让各地的Instagram用户松了一口气的是，拍照甚至能让用餐体验更加愉悦。
enjoyable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

enjoyable.sentenceEn: Our own decision-making abilities can become depleted over the course of the day causing indecision or poor choices, but choosing on behalf of someone else is an enjoyable task that doesn't suffer the same pitfalls.
enjoyable.translationZh: 我们自身的决策能力会在一天中逐渐耗尽，导致优柔寡断或错误选择，而替他人做决定则是一项愉快的任务，不会遭遇同样的问题。
enjoyable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

enjoyable.sentenceEn: The pursuit of goals may turn out to be enjoyable and pleasant.
enjoyable.translationZh: 追求目标的过程最终可能是愉悦且令人满足的。

enthusiasm.sentenceEn: In short, the Bay Area has become a global magnet for those with specialized skills, which has in turn helped fuel economic enthusiasm , and this economic growth has reduced unemployment to 3.4%, an admirable feat.
enthusiasm.translationZh: 简言之，旧金山湾区已成为吸引全球专业人才的磁石，这反过来又助推了经济热情，而经济增长将失业率降至3.4%，成就令人称道。

enthusiasm.sentenceEn: It seems unlikely that spiders will ever attract the same level of human enthusiasm as bees, birds or butterflies, in spite of their unique status as nature's spinners.
enthusiasm.translationZh: 尽管蜘蛛作为自然界的织网能手有着独特地位，但它们似乎不太可能像蜜蜂、鸟类或蝴蝶那样赢得人类同等程度的喜爱。
enthusiasm.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

enthusiasm.sentenceEn: "Instead of waiting half an hour to show enthusiasm , why not show it every eight or nine minutes?"
enthusiasm.translationZh: 为什么要等上半小时才表达热情，而不是每八到九分钟就表达一次呢？

enthusiasm.sentenceEn: "I don't think there's anything wrong with an audience showing their enthusiasm for a proper moment by applauding, showing their joy," Greenberg said, noting that the stuffiness in concert halls is "one aspect of contemporary concert etiquette" he doesn't understand.
enthusiasm.translationZh: 格林伯格说：“我认为观众在适当的时候通过鼓掌来表达热情和喜悦并没有什么不妥。”他指出，音乐厅里的这种刻板拘谨是“当代音乐会礼仪中”他无法理解的一个方面。

enthusiasm.sentenceEn: There's something about the founder's energy and enthusiasm that infects the rest of the team.
enthusiasm.translationZh: 创始人身上那种充满活力与热情的特质，总会感染团队中的其他成员。
enthusiasm.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

enthusiasm.sentenceEn: People would show greater enthusiasm for spiders than for butterflies.
enthusiasm.translationZh: 人们对蜘蛛的热情会超过对蝴蝶的热情。

excel.sentenceEn: Left-brained people are supposedly logical and excel at language and math while right-brained people are more imaginative, emotionally intelligent and skilled with spatial reasoning.
excel.translationZh: 据说左脑型的人逻辑性强，擅长语言和数学，而右脑型的人则更富有想象力，情商更高，并且在空间推理方面更有天赋。
excel.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

excel.sentenceEn: People need to remember that they are applying for a position they have the skills and experience to excel in.
excel.translationZh: 人们需要记住，他们正在申请的是一个自己拥有足够技能和经验去胜任并做出出色表现的职位。
excel.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

excel.sentenceEn: Women, it is agreed, excel at certain tasks, men at others.
excel.translationZh: 人们普遍认为，女性擅长某些任务，而男性则擅长另一些任务。
excel.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

excel.sentenceEn: Employers are looking for candidates that are intelligent and can quickly adapt and excel in a growing company.
excel.translationZh: 雇主正在寻找那些聪明伶俐、能够快速适应并在成长型公司中表现出色的候选人。
excel.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第8句

excel.sentenceEn: Pollio conducted a study that proved humour can help workers excel at routine production tasks.
excel.translationZh: 波利奥开展的一项研究证实，幽默能帮助员工在常规生产任务中表现更出色。
excel.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

excel.sentenceEn: Both Rachel and Peter excelled in their academic pursuit.
excel.translationZh: 瑞秋和彼得在学术追求上都表现出色。

exhaust.sentenceEn: Instead, they only considered the exhaust smoke emitted by finished cars, trucks, trains and planes.
exhaust.translationZh: 相反，他们只考虑了成品汽车、卡车、火车和飞机排放的废气。

exhaust.sentenceEn: They gather "data exhaust " left by employees' email and instant messaging apps, and use name badges equipped with radio-frequency identification devices and microphones.
exhaust.translationZh: 他们收集员工通过电子邮件和即时通讯应用产生的“数据废气”，并使用配备了射频识别装置和麦克风的姓名徽章。
exhaust.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

exhaust.sentenceEn: But Morton was one of the world's first conservationists, stating, "For prosperity, we ought to plant as many forests as we have exhausted and consumed".
exhaust.translationZh: 但莫顿是世界上最早的环保主义者之一，他曾说：“为了繁荣，我们应当种植与我们消耗和用尽的同样多的森林。”
exhaust.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

exhaust.sentenceEn: Soil tilling releases carbon dioxide, and delivery vehicles emit exhaust .
exhaust.translationZh: 土壤耕作会释放二氧化碳，运输车辆则会排放废气。
exhaust.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

exhaust.sentenceEn: Soon after launching EPIC's most successful product—the Bison Bacon Cranberry Bar—Collins and Forrest found they'd exhausted their sources for bison raised exclusively on pasture.
exhaust.translationZh: 在推出EPIC公司最成功的产品——野牛培根蔓越莓能量棒后不久，柯林斯和福里斯特发现，他们的纯牧场饲养野牛肉来源已经告罄。

expectancy.sentenceEn: In developing countries there is a low life expectancy , a high infant mortality rate, high levels of unemployment and illiteracy, nutritional levels below acceptable standards and widespread disease with very little or poor quality medical assistance.
expectancy.translationZh: 发展中国家的预期寿命较低，婴儿死亡率较高，失业率和文盲率居高不下，营养水平低于可接受标准，疾病普遍存在，医疗援助极少或质量低劣。
expectancy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

expectancy.sentenceEn: Chronic loneliness even impacts the life expectancy of seniors, increasing their risk of early mortality.
expectancy.translationZh: 长期孤独甚至会影响老年人的预期寿命，增加他们早逝的风险。
expectancy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

expectancy.sentenceEn: At best, if the major causes of death in developed countries were eliminated, this would only add a decade to average life expectancy .
expectancy.translationZh: 充其量，即便发达国家的主要死因被消除，平均预期寿命也只会增加十年。
expectancy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

expectancy.sentenceEn: The French take longer vacations and retire earlier, so typically work fewer hours; they enjoy a higher life expectancy , presumably reflecting advantages with respect to health care, diet, lifestyle, and the like; and income and consumption are somewhat more equally distributed there than in the U.S.
expectancy.translationZh: 法国人假期更长，退休更早，因此工作时间通常更少；他们的预期寿命更长，这可能反映出他们在医疗保健、饮食、生活方式等方面的优势；而且，法国的收入和消费分配比美国更为均衡。
expectancy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

expectancy.sentenceEn: While by no means perfect, it is considerably more comprehensive than average income, taking into account not only growth in consumption per person but also changes in working time, life expectancy , and inequality.
expectancy.translationZh: 尽管这一指标并非完美无缺，但它比平均收入指标要全面得多，不仅考虑了人均消费的增长，还包含了工作时间、预期寿命和不平等程度的变化。
expectancy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

expectancy.translationZh: 它们延长了人们的预期寿命。

exploration.sentenceEn: In 2012, for instance, Spain won a five-year legal battle against Odyssey Marine Exploration , which had hauled 594,000 gold and silver coins from a Spanish wreck off the coast of Portugal across the Atlantic to the United States.
exploration.translationZh: 例如，2012年，西班牙赢得了一场长达五年的法律诉讼，被告方是奥德赛海洋勘探公司，该公司曾从葡萄牙海岸附近的一艘西班牙沉船上打捞出59.4万枚金银币，并将其跨越大西洋运往美国。

exploration.sentenceEn: In May 2016, a salvor named Bobby Pritchett, president of Global Marine Exploration (GME) in Tampa, Florida, announced that he had discovered scattered remains of a ship buried a kilometer off Cape Canaveral.
exploration.translationZh: 2016年5月，佛罗里达州坦帕市全球海洋探索公司（GME）总裁、打捞员鲍比·普里切特宣布，他在卡纳维拉尔角外一公里处发现了一艘沉船的散落残骸。

exploration.sentenceEn: In January 1920, The New York Times ridiculed Goddard's theory that rockets could be utilized for space exploration .
exploration.translationZh: 1920年1月，《纽约时报》对戈达德提出的火箭可用于太空探索的理论加以嘲讽。
exploration.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

exploration.sentenceEn: We found that when we taught participants to ask "What if?" and "How can?" questions that nobody present would know the answer to and that would spark exploration , they engaged in better inquiry at the next exhibit—asking more questions, performing more experiments and making better interpretations of their results.
exploration.translationZh: 我们发现，当我们教参与者提出诸如“如果……会怎样？”和“如何才能……？”这类在场无人能立即回答但能激发探索欲望的问题时，他们在接下来的展览中展现出更深入的探究能力——提出更多问题、进行更多实验并对结果做出更合理的解释。
exploration.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

exploration.sentenceEn: Exploration of shipwrecks on the sea floor is crucial in updating our understanding of humanity's past.
exploration.translationZh: 对海底沉船的探索对于更新我们对人类历史的理解至关重要。

exploration.sentenceEn: Promote international collaboration in space exploration .
exploration.translationZh: 促进太空探索领域的国际合作。

elaborate.sentenceEn: The new findings are important because they elaborate our understanding of a subtle but common aspect of our daily experience.
elaborate.translationZh: 这些新发现非常重要，因为它们深化了我们对日常生活中一种微妙但却普遍存在的现象的理解。
elaborate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

elaborate.sentenceEn: We also have accepted the idea that college presidents, and their many vice-presidents, should be paid like their counterparts in the business world and that higher education requires an elaborate , up-to-date technology infrastructure.
elaborate.translationZh: 我们还接受了这样一种观念：大学校长及其众多副校长的薪酬应当与商界对应职位相当，并且高等教育需要复杂先进的技术基础设施。

elaborate.sentenceEn: We build intricate habitats, devise complex recipes for our food, wear clothes that reflect constant changes in fashion, communicate with elaborate signs, symbols, and sounds, and travel between habitats on wings and wheels of our own design.
elaborate.translationZh: 我们建造精巧复杂的居所，设计五花八门的食谱，穿着紧跟时尚潮流变化的服装，通过繁复的手势、符号和声音进行交流，还借助自己设计的翅膀与车轮穿梭于不同的栖息地之间。
elaborate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

elaborate.sentenceEn: Because great numbers of people go there, the islanders have built elaborate resorts, developed harbors and airfields, improved the beaches and have expanded sea and air routes.
elaborate.translationZh: 由于大量游客前往这些岛屿，岛民们修建了豪华度假村，开发了港口和机场，改善了海滩，并拓展了海上和空中航线。
elaborate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

elaborate.sentenceEn: Candidates shouldn't pick a broad general strength to elaborate on, such as "I'm smart, I work hard and I get things done."
elaborate.translationZh: 求职者不应选择宽泛笼统的优点来详细阐述，比如“我很聪明，工作努力，能把事情完成。”
elaborate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

elaborate.sentenceEn: No wonder it has become fashionable to denounce many universities as little more than elaborate con-tricks(骗术).
elaborate.translationZh: 难怪如今人们喜欢将许多大学斥为精心设计的骗术。
elaborate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

endangered.sentenceEn: It's the fastest-ever recovery of a mammal, joining peers like the Louisiana black bear as glowing successes in the history of the Endangered Species Act.
endangered.translationZh: 这是哺乳动物有记录以来最快的恢复案例，与路易斯安那黑熊等物种一同成为《濒危物种法案》历史上的辉煌成功典范。
endangered.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

endangered.sentenceEn: Such schools have become a model in Hawaii, but the islanders' local language is still classed by UNESCO as critically endangered because only 1,000 people speak it.
endangered.translationZh: 这类学校在夏威夷已成为典范，但由于仅1000人使用这种语言，联合国教科文组织仍将岛民的本地语言列为极度濒危语言。
endangered.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

endangered.sentenceEn: As existing crops are endangered by global warming, we can increase food security by bringing back the many forgotten food crops.
endangered.translationZh: 随着现有农作物受到全球变暖的威胁，我们可以通过重新种植许多被遗忘的粮食作物来提高粮食安全。

endangered.sentenceEn: More and more people attach importance to protecting endangered animals.
endangered.translationZh: 越来越多的人重视保护濒危动物。

enrich.sentenceEn: Gratitude is one of the healthiest and most nourishing of all states of mind, and those who adopt it as a habit are enriching not only their own lives but also the lives of those around them.
enrich.translationZh: 感恩是所有心境中最健康、最滋养人的一种，将感恩培养成习惯的人不仅在丰富自己的生活，也在丰富身边人的生活。

enrich.sentenceEn: In the information age, there's little excuse for travelers being uninformed about where their vacation money goes and who it enriches .
enrich.translationZh: 在信息时代，旅行者没有什么理由不了解自己的度假消费去向以及这些消费让谁受益。
enrich.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第10段，第2句

enrich.sentenceEn: If we shelter our children, friends, and colleagues from information that might enrich and enhance their lives, we're not being caring.
enrich.translationZh: 如果我们让孩子、朋友和同事隔绝那些可能丰富和改善他们生活的信息，那我们并非真正在关心他们。
enrich.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第4句

enrich.sentenceEn: For Copeland, the experience has not only been academically satisfying, but also has enriched his life in several ways.
enrich.translationZh: 对科普兰而言，这段经历不仅在学术上令他感到满足，还在多个方面丰富了他的人生。
enrich.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

enrich.translationZh: 它们帮助丰富了她的生活。

enroll.sentenceEn: The nation's largest university, Arizona State University, has 80,000 students on campus and aims to enroll another 100,000 students online.
enroll.translationZh: 美国规模最大的亚利桑那州立大学拥有8万名在校学生，并计划再招收10万名在线学生。

enroll.sentenceEn: This means, for instance, a CUNY student could reasonably expect to receive the same quality of instruction from a prestigious professor as they would if they were enrolled in the same class at NYU.
enroll.translationZh: 这意味着，例如，纽约市立大学的学生完全可以期待从一位知名教授那里获得与在纽约大学上同一门课同等质量的教学。

enroll.sentenceEn: Nearly half of high-earning, college-graduate parents enrolled their children in arts classes before they were 5, compared with one-fifth of low-income, less-educated parents.
enroll.translationZh: 近半数高收入、拥有大学学历的父母在孩子5岁前就为他们报名了艺术课程，而低收入、教育程度较低的父母中这一比例仅为五分之一。

enroll.sentenceEn: Most affluent parents enroll their children in preschool or day care, while low-income parents are more likely to depend on family members.
enroll.translationZh: 大多数富裕家庭的父母会为孩子报名学前班或日托，而低收入家庭的父母则更可能依赖家庭成员照料孩子。

enroll.sentenceEn: Well-off families are ruled by calendars, with children enrolled in ballet, soccer and after-school programs, according to a new Pew Research Center survey.
enroll.translationZh: 皮尤研究中心的一项新调查显示，富裕家庭的生活由日程表主导，孩子们报名参加了芭蕾舞、足球和各种课后辅导班。

enroll.sentenceEn: They will be able to enroll in expensive universities.
enroll.translationZh: 他们将能够就读昂贵的大学。

environmentalist.sentenceEn: The term " environmentalist " can mean different things.
environmentalist.translationZh: "环保主义者"这一术语可能有不同含义。
environmentalist.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

environmentalist.sentenceEn: So they're depicting me as a radical animal rights activist and environmentalist determined to force my beliefs on others.
environmentalist.translationZh: 所以他们把我描绘成一个激进的动物权利活动家和环保主义者，一心想把自己的信念强加给别人。
environmentalist.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

environmentalist.sentenceEn: To environmentalist opponents, GM foods are simply evil, an understudied, possibly harmful tool used by big agricultural businesses to control global seed markets and crush local farmers.
environmentalist.translationZh: 在环保主义反对者看来，转基因食品简直是恶魔，是大型农业企业用来控制全球种子市场、打压当地农民的一种研究不足且可能有害的工具。
environmentalist.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

environmentalist.sentenceEn: But more than that, supporters see the GM opposition of many environmentalists as fundamentally anti-science, no different than those who question the basics of man-made climate change.
environmentalist.translationZh: 但更重要的是，支持者认为许多环保主义者对转基因的反对从根本上是反科学的，这与那些质疑人为气候变化基本原理的人没有区别。
environmentalist.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第5句

environmentalist.sentenceEn: How do environmentalist opponents view GM foods according to the passage?
environmentalist.translationZh: 根据文章内容，环保主义反对者如何看待转基因食品？

environmentalist.sentenceEn: It has met much criticism from environmentalists .
environmentalist.translationZh: 它遭到了环保主义者的诸多批评。

equality.sentenceEn: Achieving gender equality in Congress is an important goal.
equality.translationZh: 在国会实现性别平等是一项重要目标。
equality.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

equality.sentenceEn: Digital exclusion is a major threat to wider societal equality in the UK, so witnessing companies like Facebook championing the metaverse(元宇宙) as the next great frontier when school children are struggling to complete their homework feels particularly irritating.
equality.translationZh: 数字排斥是英国更广泛社会平等的一大威胁，因此当看到脸书等公司将元宇宙标榜为下一个伟大前沿，而与此同时学童们却在为完成家庭作业而苦苦挣扎时，这感觉尤其令人恼火。
equality.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

equality.sentenceEn: This is an issue of equality , opportunity and national conscience.
equality.translationZh: 这关乎平等、机遇与国家良知。
equality.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

equality.sentenceEn: People get tired of hearing about Scandinavian success stories, but the fact of the matter is that Sweden, Finland and Norway have all succeeded in having about as much or faster growth in per capita(人均的) incomes than the United States and with far greater equality .
equality.translationZh: 人们已经厌倦了听到斯堪的纳维亚国家的成功故事，但事实是瑞典、芬兰和挪威都成功实现了与美国相当或更快的人均收入增长，同时保持了远高于美国的平等水平。

equality.sentenceEn: Of course, no country has ever come close to providing complete equality of opportunity.
equality.translationZh: 当然，没有哪个国家曾经真正实现过完全的机会平等。

equality.sentenceEn: It is delaying advancements toward racial equality .
equality.translationZh: 这正在阻碍种族平等进程的推进。

erosion.sentenceEn: Although many such monitoring schemes use anonymised data and participation is voluntary, many staffers remain sceptical and fear an erosion of their civil liberties.
erosion.translationZh: 尽管许多此类监控方案使用匿名数据且参与是自愿的，但不少员工仍持怀疑态度，并担心其公民自由受到侵蚀。
erosion.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

erosion.sentenceEn: These islands are low-lying, temporary sand islands that are continuously formed and destroyed through sand buildup and erosion .
erosion.translationZh: 这些岛屿是地势低洼的临时性沙岛，通过泥沙堆积和侵蚀作用不断形成又消失。

erosion.sentenceEn: The most dangerous thing for these remote island dwellers is land erosion .
erosion.translationZh: 对于这些偏远岛屿的居民来说，最危险的事情是土地侵蚀。

erosion.sentenceEn: Victims of erosion lose their houses, agricultural land and jobs as farmers, fishermen and day laborers.
erosion.translationZh: 土地侵蚀的受害者失去了房屋、农田以及作为农民、渔民和日工的生计。

erosion.sentenceEn: They are home to over six million people, who face repeated displacement from flooding and erosion —which may be getting worse because of climate change—and a range of health risks, including poor nutrition, malaria(疟疾) and other water-borne diseases.
erosion.translationZh: 这些岛屿是六百多万人的家园，他们因洪水和侵蚀而不断流离失所——而气候变化可能使这种情况愈发严重——同时还面临一系列健康风险，包括营养不良、疟疾及其他水传播疾病。

erosion.sentenceEn: The residents of the river islands have to keep moving their homes because of floods and land erosions .
erosion.translationZh: 这些河中岛屿的居民因洪水和土地侵蚀而不得不频繁迁移家园。

establishment.sentenceEn: Those are a few strategies for dealing with today's American medical establishment .
establishment.translationZh: 这些是应对当今美国医疗体系的一些策略。
establishment.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

establishment.sentenceEn: Hobbyists and students are gaining access to technologies without being part of a long-standing amateur establishment .
establishment.translationZh: 业余爱好者和学生们正在接触这些技术，却无需加入历史悠久的业余爱好者组织。

establishment.sentenceEn: We are not the ones to decide on the establishment of marine protected areas, but we hope to contribute positively with our knowledge and experience.
establishment.translationZh: 我们并非负责决定建立海洋保护区的机构，但我们希望能凭借自身的知识和经验做出积极贡献。
establishment.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第4句

establishment.sentenceEn: W: Well, we saw the opportunity to offer something a little special and different from other establishments .
establishment.translationZh: 是这样，我们看到了一个机会，能提供一些与众不同、独具特色的东西，这和其他咖啡店都不一样。
establishment.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

establishment.sentenceEn: So how is your establishment any different?
establishment.translationZh: 那么您的店有什么不同之处呢？
establishment.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

establishment.sentenceEn: It will result in the establishment of the world's largest marine reserve.
establishment.translationZh: 该区域还将成为世界上最大的海洋保护区

exception.sentenceEn: The ongoing conservative civil war often degenerates into content-free tribal warfare, but trade is a rare exception .
exception.translationZh: 持续不断的保守派内战常常演变成缺乏实质内容的派系之争，但贸易问题却是一个罕见的例外。

exception.sentenceEn: Thus, humans are creators as a rule rather than as an exception .
exception.translationZh: 因此，人类天生就是创造者，而非例外。
exception.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第5句

exception.sentenceEn: For babies younger than 18 months, AAP still says no screens at all are the best idea—with one notable exception : Live video chat.
exception.translationZh: 对于18个月以下的婴儿，美国儿科学会（AAP）仍然认为完全不接触屏幕是最佳做法，但有一个明显的例外：实时视频聊天。
exception.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

exception.sentenceEn: The big exception is China, where spending has far surpassed other countries over the past decade.
exception.translationZh: 中国是一个显著的例外，在过去十年中，中国在农业研究上的投入远远超过了其他国家。
exception.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

exception.sentenceEn: Dual-language programs can be an exception .
exception.translationZh: 双语教学项目可能是个例外。

exception.sentenceEn: Some communities have agreed to share online—geneticists, for example, post DNA sequences at the GenBank repository(库), and astronomers are accustomed to accessing images of galaxies and stars from, say, the Sloan Digital Sky Survey, a telescope that has observed some 500 million objects—but these remain the exception , not the rule.
exception.translationZh: 一些学术群体已经同意在线共享数据——例如，遗传学家会将DNA序列发布到GenBank数据库，天文学家则习惯于通过诸如斯隆数字巡天望远镜（该望远镜已观测约5亿个天体）获取星系和恒星的图像——但这些仍属例外，而非普遍现象。
exception.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

exhausted.sentenceEn: In 1912, Lester Wire was a police officer exhausted by traffic at Main Street and 200 South.
exhausted.translationZh: 1912年，警察莱斯特·怀尔被主街和200南路交汇处的繁忙交通搞得疲惫不堪。

exhausted.sentenceEn: Or you prepared meals on Sunday and stuck to eating healthy dinners at home, but by Friday you found yourself so exhausted and opted to order greasy takeout.
exhausted.translationZh: 或者你周日准备了餐食，坚持在家吃健康晚餐，但到了周五却感到筋疲力尽，选择点油腻的外卖。

exhausted.sentenceEn: How do we motivate a public exhausted by never-ending scenarios of doom and disaster, when the challenges seem so huge and so impossible to solve?
exhausted.translationZh: 当挑战看起来如此艰巨、几乎无法解决时，我们该如何激励那些因没完没了的末日灾难场景而感到疲惫不堪的公众呢？

exhausted.sentenceEn: We feel exhausted and need breaks between demanding mental tasks.
exhausted.translationZh: 我们会感到疲惫，在进行高强度脑力任务之间需要休息。
exhausted.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第5句

exhausted.sentenceEn: If workers are exhausted to a dangerous degree, it is extremely hard for them to transition to the next task.
exhausted.translationZh: 如果员工疲惫到危险程度，他们将极难过渡到下一项任务。

exhausted.sentenceEn: They may become exhausted by making too many decisions for themselves.
exhausted.translationZh: 他们可能会因为为自己做了太多决定而感到疲惫不堪。

extensive.sentenceEn: Further, an extensive search of land ownership records in Athens does not seem to indicate Jackson ever owned the land the tree sits on.
extensive.translationZh: 此外，对雅典土地所有权记录的广泛搜索似乎并未显示杰克逊曾拥有那棵树所在的土地。

extensive.sentenceEn: Previous studies have suggested that other animals, including pigeons, dolphins, honeybees and some primates(灵长类动物), can discern same from different, but only after extensive training.
extensive.translationZh: 此前的研究表明，包括鸽子、海豚、蜜蜂和一些灵长类动物在内的其他动物能够分辨相同与不同，但这需要经过大量训练。
extensive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第10段，第1句

extensive.sentenceEn: As machine learning algorithms improve and as they train on more extensive data sets, larger parts of everyday life are likely to become utterly predictable.
extensive.translationZh: 随着机器学习算法的改进以及对更广泛数据集的训练，日常生活中越来越多的方面可能会变得完全可预测。
extensive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

extensive.sentenceEn: It takes hard work and extensive preparation to answer this question well.
extensive.translationZh: 要回答好这个问题，需要下一番功夫并进行充分准备。
extensive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第5句

extensive.sentenceEn: No proof has been found from an extensive search that Jackson had ever owned the land where the oak tree grew.
extensive.translationZh: 经过广泛调查，并未发现任何证据表明杰克逊曾拥有那棵橡树生长的土地。

extensive.sentenceEn: Gain extensive recognition without exposing pure indulgence.
extensive.translationZh: 在不表现出纯粹放纵的情况下获得广泛认可。

extracurricular.sentenceEn: But in the state sector the excessive focus on English, maths and science threatens to crush arts subjects; meanwhile, reduced school budgets mean diminishing extracurricular activities.
extracurricular.translationZh: 但在公立教育体系中，对英语、数学和科学的过度重视可能会压制艺术学科；同时，学校预算的缩减意味着课外活动的减少。
extracurricular.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

extracurricular.sentenceEn: The author, composer and psychologist Glenn Schellenberg had conducted an experiment with 144 children randomly assigned to four groups: one learned the keyboard for a year, one took singing lessons, one joined an acting class, and a control group had no extracurricular training.
extracurricular.translationZh: 该论文作者——作曲家兼心理学家格伦·舍伦贝格(Glenn Schellenberg)——对144名儿童进行了一项实验，这些儿童被随机分为四组：一组学习了一年键盘乐器，一组参加声乐课程，一组加入表演班，而对照组则不接受任何课外培训。

extracurricular.sentenceEn: To establish whether effects such as improved concentration are caused by music participation itself, and not by investing time in an extracurricular activity of any kind, Assal Habibi, a psychology professor at the University of Southern California, is conducting a five-year longitudinal study with children from low-income communities in Los Angeles.
extracurricular.translationZh: 为了确定诸如注意力提升等效果是否由参与音乐活动本身引起，而非仅仅因为投入时间参与任何类型的课外活动，南加州大学心理学教授阿萨尔·哈比比正在对洛杉矶低收入社区的儿童开展一项为期五年的纵向研究。

extracurricular.sentenceEn: According to a 2012 survey described in The Atlantic, college reputation ranked lowest in relative importance of attributes in evaluating graduates for hire, beaten out by top factors like internships, employment during college, college major, volunteer experience, and extracurriculars .
extracurricular.translationZh: 《大西洋月刊》报道的一项2012年调查显示，在评估毕业生是否值得聘用时，大学声誉的相对重要性排名最低，被实习经历、在校期间工作经验、大学专业、志愿者经历和课外活动等主要因素远远甩在后面。

extracurricular.sentenceEn: In order to be admitted to a prestigious university, the author took part in various extracurricular activities and attended test preparation courses.
extracurricular.translationZh: 为了被名牌大学录取，作者参加了各种课外活动并上了备考课程。

elementary.sentenceEn: "You can't sprinkle in a little phonics," says Tenette Smith, executive director of elementary education and reading at Mississippi's education department.
elementary.translationZh: 密西西比州教育部小学教育与阅读部门执行主任特内特·史密斯表示：“不能只是零星地教一点 phonics。”
elementary.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第6句

elementary.sentenceEn: There's a debate over whether it's appropriate to teach coding in elementary schools, with fierce opinions on each side.
elementary.translationZh: 关于在小学教授编程是否合适存在争议，双方意见分歧激烈。

elementary.sentenceEn: This decrease in cost allows researchers, hobbyists and even elementary school groups to put simple instruments into LEO or even have them deployed from the ISS.
elementary.translationZh: 成本的降低使得研究人员、业余爱好者甚至小学生团体都能够将简单仪器送入近地轨道，甚至可以从国际空间站部署这些仪器。

elementary.sentenceEn: A low wage for elementary school teachers, however, doesn't mean elementary education isn't important.
elementary.translationZh: 然而，小学教师薪资偏低并不意味着小学教育不重要。
elementary.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

elementary.sentenceEn: It simply means there are too many elementary school teachers already.
elementary.translationZh: 这只简单地说明小学教师已经供过于求了。
elementary.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

elementary.sentenceEn: Elementary schoolchildren will be frustrated when taught with several methods combined.
elementary.translationZh: 如果同时采用多种方法教小学生阅读，他们会感到困惑。

emulate.sentenceEn: Emulating tardigrades could one day help humans colonize outer space.
emulate.translationZh: 有朝一日，模仿缓步动物可能会帮助人类开拓外太空殖民地。
emulate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

emulate.sentenceEn: Those who have produced their own music, or even fans of authentic, artistic music, will also argue that a computer could never emulate the work (and human touch) of a true musician.
emulate.translationZh: 那些自己创作音乐的人，甚至是真正艺术音乐的爱好者，也会认为计算机永远无法模仿真正音乐家的作品（以及其中的人文温度）。
emulate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

emulate.sentenceEn: They are often emulating bad managers they've had in the past.
emulate.translationZh: 他们往往在效仿自己过去遇到的糟糕管理者。
emulate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第7句

emulate.sentenceEn: Emulating your conversation partner's actions is a common human behavior classified as "mirroring" and has been known and studied by psychologists for years.
emulate.translationZh: 模仿交谈对象的动作是一种常见的人类行为，被称为“镜像行为”，心理学家已对其进行了多年的研究。
emulate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

emulate.sentenceEn: So far, machines have a pretty hard time emulating creativity, arbitrary enough not to be predicted by a computer, and yet more than simple randomness.
emulate.translationZh: 到目前为止，机器在模仿创造力方面仍有相当大的困难，那种创造力足够任意而不会被计算机预测，同时又不仅仅是简单的随机性。
emulate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第11句

emulate.sentenceEn: Music created with AI technology is easily emulated .
emulate.translationZh: 利用人工智能技术创作的音乐很容易被模仿。

entail.sentenceEn: Creating a gap between her income and spending required a paradigm shift and entailed sacrifice and commitment, but by going into financial lockdown, Nicole gained financial independence.
entail.translationZh: 要在收入和支出之间创造差距，需要彻底转变观念，并意味着要做出牺牲和承诺。但通过实施财务封锁，妮可获得了经济独立。
entail.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

entail.sentenceEn: Virtually every activity that entails or facilitates in-person human interaction seems to be in the midst of a total meltdown as the coronavirus(冠状病毒) outbreak erases Americans' desire to travel.
entail.translationZh: 随着冠状病毒疫情爆发，美国人的出行意愿荡然无存，几乎所有需要或促进人际当面互动的活动似乎都正处于全面崩溃之中。
entail.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

entail.sentenceEn: What kind of responsibilities does that job entail ?
entail.translationZh: 这份工作需要承担哪些职责呢？
entail.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

entail.sentenceEn: There is no doubt that spaceflight entails risks, and to pioneer a new mode of travel is to free those risks, and to reduce them with the benefit of hard-won experience.
entail.translationZh: 毫无疑问，太空飞行伴随着风险，而开创一种新的旅行方式就是要直面这些风险，并借助来之不易的经验来降低风险。
entail.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

entail.sentenceEn: What does solidarity entail according to the passage?
entail.translationZh: 根据文章内容，团结的具体含义是什么？

entail.sentenceEn: It is likely to entail serious consequences.
entail.translationZh: 这可能会带来严重的后果。

enthusiastic.sentenceEn: We get these super lunar events by smashing together all the qualifiers we've historically used to keep track of full moons throughout the year, and in the age of the internet we can get a little too enthusiastic .
enthusiastic.translationZh: 我们将历史上用来记录全年满月的各种限定词拼凑在一起，就有了这些超级月亮现象；而在互联网时代，我们对此可能有些过于热衷了。

enthusiastic.sentenceEn: Among these children, Schneider has found that those who were enthusiastic about music and who practiced voluntarily showed improvements in hearing ability, as well as in more general competencies, such as the ability to concentrate.
enthusiastic.translationZh: 在这些儿童中，施耐德发现那些对音乐充满热情且自愿练习的孩子，其听力能力有所提高，同时在更广泛的能力方面也表现出进步，例如专注力。

enthusiastic.sentenceEn: We've got triple the space, but we've become such enthusiastic consumers that we require even more.
enthusiastic.translationZh: 我们拥有的空间增加了两倍，但我们却成了如此狂热的消费者，以至于需要更多的空间。
enthusiastic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

enthusiastic.sentenceEn: Your working life lasts an average of forty years, so it's important to find a job you like and feel enthusiastic about.
enthusiastic.translationZh: 一个人的职业生涯平均长达四十年，因此找到一份自己喜欢且充满热情的工作至关重要。
enthusiastic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

enthusiastic.sentenceEn: W: You don't sound very enthusiastic .
enthusiastic.translationZh: 听起来你不是很有热情嘛。
enthusiastic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

enthusiastic.sentenceEn: They call for enthusiastic support from the workforce.
enthusiastic.translationZh: 他们呼吁全体员工给予热情支持。

entity.sentenceEn: Professor Oliver claims that individualism is actually bad for society, and only by realising we are part of a bigger entity can we solve pressing environmental and societal problems.
entity.translationZh: 奥利弗教授认为，个人主义实际上对社会有害，只有认识到我们是更大整体的一部分，我们才能解决紧迫的环境和社会问题。
entity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

entity.sentenceEn: On close inspection, it becomes clear that the norm is constantly evolving and therefore is not a constant entity .
entity.translationZh: 仔细审视便会发现，所谓的“常态”其实在不断演变，因此并非一成不变的实体。
entity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

entity.sentenceEn: "Instead of focusing only on the conservation of genetically based entities like species, we now need to also consider culturally based entities ," says Andrew Whiten.
entity.translationZh: 安德鲁·怀滕说：“我们不应只专注于保护物种等基于基因的实体，现在还需要考虑基于文化的实体。”
entity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第2句

entity.sentenceEn: That's why this new policy also includes directions to update the current U.S. Government Orbital Debris Mitigation Standard Practices, which already require any entity that launches a satellite or spacecraft to vigorously analyze the likelihood that any of their actions, from an unexpected failure or normal operations, will create more space debris.
entity.translationZh: 这就是为什么这项新政策还包括更新现行《美国政府轨道碎片减缓标准规范》的指示，该规范已要求任何发射卫星或航天器的实体必须认真分析其行为（无论是意外故障还是正常运行）产生更多太空碎片的可能性。
entity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

entity.sentenceEn: What is a space vehicle launching entity required to do according to the current U.S. Government Orbital Debris Mitigation Standard Practices?
entity.translationZh: 根据现行美国政府轨道碎片减缓标准规范，航天器发射实体需要做什么？

entity.sentenceEn: Focus entirely on culturally-based entities rather than genetically-based ones.
entity.translationZh: 完全专注于基于文化的实体，而非基于基因的实体。

entrepreneurial.sentenceEn: Sticking with the example of the entrepreneurial venture, numbers are your best friend.
entrepreneurial.translationZh: 以创业投资为例，数据就是你最好的朋友。

entrepreneurial.sentenceEn: If you're considering whether to shut down your entrepreneurial venture, for instance, reach out to other founders as opposed to just your business partner.
entrepreneurial.translationZh: 例如，如果你正在考虑是否关闭你的创业项目，请去联系其他创始人，而不仅仅是咨询你的商业伙伴。

entrepreneurial.sentenceEn: These outcomes include economic activity, for example, entrepreneurial start-up rates, and also crime rates, health behaviors, and health outcomes.
entrepreneurial.translationZh: 这些结果包括经济活动（例如创业公司成立率），还包括犯罪率、健康行为和健康结果。
entrepreneurial.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

entrepreneurial.sentenceEn: But most of the coins have already been removed by entrepreneurial New Yorkers and there is not a significant amount left to be collected.
entrepreneurial.translationZh: 但大多数硬币早已被一些有“商业头脑”的纽约人取走，留给公园工作人员收集的已经所剩无几。
entrepreneurial.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

entrepreneurial.sentenceEn: He was also a skilled and sophisticated organizer, an entrepreneurial innovator, who mastered the use of corporate strategy, media relations, government lobbying, international diplomacy, patents, and prosecution.
entrepreneurial.translationZh: 他还是一位技艺高超、精明老练的组织者，一位富有创业精神的创新者，精通企业战略、媒体关系、政府游说、国际外交、专利申请以及专利诉讼。

error.sentenceEn: To its credit, the FAO immediately owned up to its error .
